Source:
Sub Main()
	Dim A as Long, B as Long, C as Long, D as Long, E as Long, F as Long
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	 If IsPlaying(A) & GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
		B = B + 1
		C = C + GetPlayerLevel(A)
		If GetPlayerLevel(A) = 80 Then D = D + 1
		If GetPlayerGuild(A) > 0 Then F = F + 1
	 End If
	Next A
	E = Divide(C, B)
	F = Divide(F * 100, B)
	GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat(Str(B), " Players' Average Level:  "), Str(E)), WHITE)
	GlobalMessage(StrCat("Players at Level 80:  ", Str(D)), WHITE)
	GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat("Guilded Population:  ", Str(F)), "%"), WHITE)
'	GlobalMessage("Players' Average IQ: 4", White)
End Sub

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS STRING) AS LONG

if getflag(2) = 0 & getplayeraccess(player) = 0 then
playermessage(player,"Broadcast is currently disabled.",yellow)
main = stop
exit function
end if

If getplayerflag(player,2) = 1 & getplayeraccess(player) = 0 & getplayerflag(player, 73) = 0 then
playermessage(player,strcat("You may only broadcast every ",strcat(str(getflag(2))," seconds.")),yellow)
main = stop
exit function
end if

if getplayerflag(player,2) = 0 & getplayeraccess(player) = 0 then
setplayerflag(player,2,1)
timer(player, getflag(2), "globaltimer")
end if

if getplayermap(player) = 666 then
playermessage(player,"You can not broadcast in hell, loser.",brightred)
main = stop
exit function
end if

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 681 Then
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Check out the Quest Guides on the web site for help.  Other players are also a great source of help.  Join us on the forums if you have any questions!", BRIGHTGREEN)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Don't forget to type /rules and read the laws of the land, otherwise you may be punished!", BrightGreen)
End if

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 1 | GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then
   If GetFlag(83) = 1 | GetFlag(84) = 1 Then
      Main = Continue
      Exit Function
   End If
End If

main = continue
END FUNCTION

Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetFlag(82) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Carnage warp has ended.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerAccess(Player) = 0 Then
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 666 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 301 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 68 | GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot warp to Carnage from jail, hell or waiting room.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
	If GetMapIsFriendly(GetPlayerMap(Player)) = False Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be on a friendly map to warp to Carnage.", Yellow)
		Exit Sub
	End If
Else
	If GetMapIsPK(GetPlayerMap(Player)) = True Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be on a friendly map to warp to Carnage.", Yellow)
		Exit Sub
	End If
End If
If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 5 | GetTileAtt2(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 5 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not warp to Carnage from vaults.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If
End If

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 210, GetPlayerMap(Player))
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 211, GetPlayerX(Player))
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 212, GetPlayerY(Player))
PlayerWarp(Player, 68, 5, 5)
PlayerMessage(Player, "You have been warped to Carnage!", Yellow)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player AS LONG, Target AS LONG)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 90) = 1 Then 'Cleric Res
		If GetPlayerIsDead(Player) = 0 Then
			RunScript2("res", Player, Target)
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 94) = 1 Then 'Mage Telepathy
		If GetPlayerAccess(Target) = 0 Then
			RunScript2("playerscan", Player, Target)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Gods are unaffected by your pesky mind tricks.", Grey)
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 96) > 0 Then 'Mage Sacrifice
		RunScript2("sacrifice", Player, Target)
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 204) > 0 Then	'Mage Evil Eye
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 & GetPlayerGuild(Target) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Unguildeds may not spy on Guildeds.", Grey)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 204, 0)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Your Evil Eye is now tracking ", GetPlayerName(Target)), Yellow)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 209, Target)
				Timer(Player, 20, "Tag")
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 204, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
				RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
			End If
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast.", Grey)
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 208) = 1 Then	'Cleric Damnation
		If GetPlayerIsDead(Target) = True Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) <> 2 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Target, 15, 2)
				Map = GetPlayerMap(Target)
				X = GetPlayerX(Target)
				Y = GetPlayerY(Target)
				RunScript4("Explosion", Player, Map, X, Y)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "This soul has exploded.", White)
			End If
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 78) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " is one of Fank's Henchmen!"), Green)
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 218) > 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), strcat(" has ruled over ToF Run ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Target, 218)), " times!"))), Green)
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 218) = 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has ruled over ToF Run!"), Green)
		End If
	End If
'	If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 125) > 0 Then
'		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has received knowledge of the Dark Arts!"), Blue)
'	End If
	Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Target, 215)
		Case 1
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has slain the Champ single handed!"), Red)
		Case 2
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has slain the Bremen in close quarters!"), Red)
		Case 3
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has slain the Vorpal Bunny in close quarters!"), Red)
		Case 4
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has stared into the eyes of Death and preveiled!"), Red)
	End Select
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 196) = 1 Then	'Cleric Damnation
			'If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) <> 2 Then
				'SetPlayerFlag(Target, 15, 2)
				Map = GetPlayerMap(Target)
				X = GetPlayerX(Target)
				Y = GetPlayerY(Target)
				RunScript4("magespell2", Player, Map, X, Y)
			'Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "This soul has exploded.", White)
			'End If
			End if
End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long, Command as String, Parm1 as String, Parm2 as String, Parm3 as String, Parm4 as String) AS LONG
dim Target as Long

Target = FindPlayer(Parm1)

'God Commands
If GetPlayerAccess(Player) > 0 Then
	If strcmp(Command, "scriptban") Then
		BanPlayer(Target, Val(Parm2), Parm3)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "restore") Then
		RunScript2("restore", Player, Target)
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "user") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), strcat(" - ", GetPlayerUser(Target))), White)
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "ip") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), strcat(" - ", GetPlayerIP(Target))), White)
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "light") Then
		SetOutdoorLight (Val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "level") Then
		RunScript2("level", Target, Val(Parm2))
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "average") Then
		RunScript0 ("Average")
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "globaltimer") Then
		RunScript1("GlobalCommand", Val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "get") Then
		If Val(Parm2) = 0 Then Parm2 = "1"
		GiveObj(Player, Val(Parm1), Val(Parm2))
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "give") Then
		GiveObj(Target, Val(Parm2), Val(Parm3))
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have given ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), strcat(" ", strcat(Parm3, strcat(" ", GetObjectName(Val(Parm2))))))), Yellow)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "take") Then
		TakeObj(Target, Val(Parm2), Val(Parm3))
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have taken ", strcat(Parm3, strcat(" ", strcat(GetObjectName(Val(Parm2)), strcat(" from ", GetPlayerName(Target)))))), Yellow)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "run") Then
		RunScript0(Parm1)
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Command, "macropwn") Then
		RunScript1("macropwn", Target)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "scan") Then
		RunScript2("scan", Player, Target)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "class") Then
		SetPlayerClass(Player, val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "checkinvis") Then
		RunScript1("CheckInvis", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

 	If StrCmp(Command, "setflag") Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Target, Val(Parm2), Val(Parm3))
		Exit Function
	End If
	
 	If StrCmp(Command, "setsflag") Then
		SetFlag(Val(Parm1), Val(Parm2))
		Exit Function
	End If
	
 	If StrCmp(Command, "getsflag") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, Str(GetFlag(Val(Parm1))), WHITE)
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If Strcmp(Command, "lavos123") & getplayeraccess(player) > 0 Then
		SetEquippedItemSuffix(Player,5,255)
		'GlobalMessage("You hear volcanic eruptions in the distance indicating Fire Lord Lavos will ascend from the depths in 25 minutes.", Brightred)
	End if
	
	If Strcmp(Command, "lavostimer") & getplayeraccess(player) > 0 Then
	setflag(184, 30)
	End if
	

'Event Commands
	If strcmp(Command, "TOFhost") Then
		RunScript0("TofHost")
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "ChampHost") Then
		RunScript0 ("ChampHost")
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "ChampBan") Then
		RunScript2("ChampBan", Player, Target)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "LotteryHost") Then
		RunScript2("LotteryHost", Player, val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "LotteryStart") Then
		RunScript0("LotteryStart")
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "LotteryList") Then
		RunScript0("LotteryList")
		Exit Function
	End If

'Pictures
	If strcmp(Command, "bunnyxyz") Then RunScript0 ("bunny")
	If strcmp(Command, "batxyz") Then RunScript0 ("bat")
	If strcmp(Command, "devilxyz") Then RunScript0 ("devil")

	If strcmp(Command, "marstest") Then RunScript2("MarsTest", Player, val(Parm1))
	
	If StrCmp(Command, "res") Then RunScript2("GodRes", Player, Val(Parm1))
End If

PlayerMessage(Player, "Invalid command!", Yellow)

End Function

Name: spell117
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, Mana as Long
'Static Tear - Mage Spell 13
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1427 Then Exit Sub
Effect = 10
Mana = 3
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player)
	If GetPlayerStrength(Player) > 0 Then Damage = Damage - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) +2),5)
Damage = Damage - 4
	If Damage < 0 Then Damage = 0

If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	Exit Sub
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
CreatePlayerMagicProjectile(Player, GetPlayerDirection(Player), Effect, Damage)

End Sub

function main(player as long) as long

if hasobj(player,508) = 1 | hasobj(player,509) = 1 then
SetPlayerStatus(Player, 24)
      Main = Stop
      Exit Function
else
SetPlayerStatus(Player, 0)
      Main = continue
      Exit Function
end if
   End If

end function

Name: COMMAND
Source:
FUNCTION Main(Player as LONG, Command as String, Parm1 as String, Parm2 as String, Parm3 as String) AS LONG
Dim A As Long, B As Long, C As Long, D As Long, E As Long, Target As Long

Main = Stop
Target = FindPlayer(Parm1)

'General
	If strcmp(Command, "sprite") Then
		RunScript2("SetSprite", Player, Val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If strcmp(Command, "status") Then
		RunScript2("SetStatus", Player, Val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "quests") Then
		RunScript1("QuestLog", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

'	If strcmp(Command, "unfreeze") | strcmp(Command, "u") Then
'		RunScript1("CheckFrozen", Player)
'		Exit Function
'	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "Artifacts") Then
		RunScript1("Artifact", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "rules") Then
		RunScript1("Rules", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

'Market
	If strcmp(Command, "Lottery") Then
		RunScript1("Lottery", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

'Store
	If strcmp(Command, "Incognito") Then
		RunScript1("Incognito", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "FloatText") & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 72) = 1 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Function
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
		Timer(Player, 1, "PushTimer")
		If strlen(Parm1) <= 25 Then
			CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, Parm1, Val(Parm2))
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Message is too long.", Grey)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "Push") Then
		RunScript1("Push", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "Guard") Then
		If IsPlaying(Target) Then RunScript2("Guard", Player, Target)
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	'if strcmp(command, "attack") then
	'if getplayerguild(player) = getflag(186) & getflag(185) > 0 then 
	'	If IsPlaying(Target) Then RunScript2("attack", Player, Target)
		
	'else
	'playermessage(player, "Your guild does not have special access to the Darkcone Fort.", white)
	'Exit Function
	'end if
	'end if
	
	
	
	'If strcmp(Command, "Attack") & if getplayerguild(player) = getflag(186) & getflag(185) > 0 then 
	'Fort
		'If strcmp(Command, "fort") Then
		'If IsPlaying(Target) Then RunScript2("attack", Player, Target)
		'Exit Function
	'End If

	If strcmp(Command, "PkRemove") Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 77) = 1 Then SetPlayerStatus(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 133))
		Exit Function
	End If
'Party
	If strcmp(Command, "party") Then
		If strcmp(Parm1, "") Then
			RunScript0("party")
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "new") Then
			RunScript1("partynew", Player)
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "invite") Then
			RunScript2("partyinvite", Player, FindPlayer(Parm2))
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "join") Then
			RunScript1("partyjoin", Player)
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "leave") Then
			RunScript1("partyleave", Player)
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "leader") Then
			RunScript2("partyleader", Player, FindPlayer(Parm2))
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "boot") Then
			RunScript2("partyboot", Player, FindPlayer(Parm2))
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "roll") Then
			RunScript1("partyroll", Player)
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "who") Then
			RunScript1("partywho", Player)
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Parm1, "chat") Then
			RunScript0("partychat")
			Exit Function
		End If
		If StrCmp(Parm1, "help") Then
			RunScript1("partyhelp", Player)
			Exit Function
		End If
		
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is an invalid Party command.", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	End If

'Player God Commands
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 78) > 0 | GetPlayerAccess(Player) > 0 | GetPlayerFlag(Player, 74) = 1 Then
		If strcmp(Command, "Boot") Then
			A = FindPlayer(Parm1)
			If IsPlaying(A) Then
				If strcmp(Parm2, "") Then
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You must enter a good, descriptive reason", WHITE)
				Else
					BootPlayer(A, StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has booted you - "), Parm2))
				End If
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Player not found", WHITE)
			End If
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Command, "Ban") Then
			A = FindPlayer(Parm1)
			If IsPlaying(A) Then
				If strcmp(Parm2, "") Then
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You must enter a good, descriptive reason", WHITE)
				Else
					If GetPlayerAccess(Player) = 0 Then
						BanPlayer(A, 1, StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has banned you - "), Parm2))
					Else
						PlayerMessage(Player, "That player is a god.", Grey)
					End If
				End If
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Player not found", WHITE)
			End If
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Command, "Jail") Then
			RunScript3("GODJAIL", Player, Target, Val(Parm2))
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Command, "Squelch") Then
			RunScript3("GODSQUELCH", Player, Target, Val(Parm2))
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If

'Minigames
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 40) = 0 Then 'Jail
	If strcmp(Command, "Carn") Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) > 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Minigame.", Grey)
		Else
			Runscript1("Carn", Player)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If strcmp(Command, "Tof") Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) > 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Minigame.", Grey)
		Else
			RunScript1("TOF", Player)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "Champ") Then
		If GetFlag(90) <> Player & GetFlag(95) <> Player Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Minigame.", Grey)
			Else
				RunScript1("Champ", Player)
			End If
			Exit Function
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in Solo the Champ.", Grey)
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	
	If strcmp(Command, "Tourny") Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) > 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Minigame.", Grey)
		Else
			RunScript1("Tournament", Player)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If strcmp(Command, "saveme") Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 2100, 1, 11) 'catch exploiter
			'MapMessage(2100, "saveme", brightgreen) ' to see who exploits
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If strcmp(Command, "fille") Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 2100, 1, 11) 'catch exploiter
		'SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Player))
		'MapMessage(2100, "fille", Brightgreen) 'to see who exploits

		Exit Function
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cant escape that easily...", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

RunScript0("Command2")

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long, Game as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Message1 as String, Message2 as String

Message1 = "Red Team: "
Message2 = "Blue Team: "
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = Game Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Message1 = strcat(Message1, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Message2 = strcat(Message2, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

GlobalMessage("==Minigame Teams==", Yellow)
GlobalMessage(Message1, Red)
GlobalMessage(Message2, Blue)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player AS LONG)
   Dim N as Long
   If GetPlayerLevel(Player) = 1 & GetPlayerExperience(Player) = 0 & GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1 Then
      If GetPlayerClass(Player) = 1 Then
         For N = 1 to 510
            If HasObj(Player, N) Then
               PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot bring anything into Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
               PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)
               Exit Sub
            End If
         Next N
         SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 1)
         PlayerMessage(Player, "Welcome to Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
         PlayerWarp(Player, 79, 5, 5)
      Else
         PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be a Knight to enter Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
      End If
   Else
      PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be level 1 and be on map 1 to enter Capture the Flag!", WHITE)
   End If
End Sub

if getplayermap(player) = 666 | getplayermap(player) = 301 | getplayermap(player) = 68 | GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 1 then

if getflag(84) = 1 then

playermessage(player,"You have been instantly warped to the equal opportunity carnage!",yellow)
exit sub
else
playermessage(player,"Carnage warp has ended, sorry!",yellow)
exit sub

end if

Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

	GlobalMessage("A Free For All Carnage has started!", 9)
	GlobalMessage("Map: The Farm",white)
	  
SetFlag(82, 0)
For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(A) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(A) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
				SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A, 9)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, 0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A, 32)
				PlayerWarp(A, 606, 3 + random(7), 3 + random(7))
			Else
				PlayerWarp(A, 606, 2, 1)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next A

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long, Map as Long, Time as Long)
dim CarnScript as String

Select Case Map
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Available FFA Maps:", BrightBlue)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1 - Carnage", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2 - Chess", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3 - PacMan", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "4 - Farm", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "5 - Original", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "6 - Original2", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "7 - SOC", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "8 - End", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "9 - Halloween", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "10 - Ruins", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "11 - Underworld", White)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "12 - Volcano", White)
		Exit Sub
	Case 1
		CarnScript = "Carnage"
	Case 2
		CarnScript = "Chess"
	Case 3
		CarnScript = "PacMan"
	Case 4
		CarnScript = "Farm"
	Case 5
		CarnScript = "Original"
	Case 6
		CarnScript = "Original2"
	Case 7
		CarnScript = "SOC"
	Case 8
		CarnScript = "End"
	Case 9
		CarnScript = "Halloween"
	Case 10
		CarnScript = "Ruins"
	Case 11
		CarnScript = "Underworld"
	Case 12
		CarnScript = "Volcano"
End Select
	
If Time = 0 Then
	RunScript1(CarnScript, Player)
Else
	Timer(1, Time, CarnScript)
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(CarnScript, strcat(" runs in ", strcat(str(Time), " seconds."))), White)
End If

End Sub

function main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long

globalmessage("A Random Team Carnage has started!",brightblue)
globalmessage("Map: Team Fortress Carnage",white)

b = 0
c = 0
d = 0
setflag(60,0)
setflag(61,0)


'//========Teams=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers

If getplayermap(a)= 68 then
if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
b = random(1)

if b = 0 then

if c >= d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 102)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 94)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
end if

else

if c < d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 94)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 102)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
end if

end if
else
end if
else
end if

next a

'//========Warp=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(A) = 68 then
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 30 Then PlayerWarp(A, 110, 0, 6)
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then PlayerWarp(A, 110, 11, 6)
 If GetPlayerAccess(A) > 5 Then PlayerWarp(A, 110, 1, 1)
end if
next a

end function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
Dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long, B as Long
''Cook Potions

Ration = HasObj(Player, 445) + HasObj(Player, 446) + HasObj(Player, 447)

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
	If A = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to create potions", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If
If HasObj(Player, 403) = 0 | HasObj(Player, 286) < 10 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have all the ingredients required.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

If Ration < 2 Then
'20 Scorpian Stings => Strength Potion
	If HasObj(Player, 78) >= 20 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 78, 20)
		GiveObj(Player, 445, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 20 Scorpian Stings into a Strength Potion!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
'20 Marshrooms => Endurance Potion
		If HasObj(Player, 69) >= 20 Then
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 20)
			GiveObj(Player, 446, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 20 Marshroom into an Endurance Potion!", Yellow)
			Exit Function
		Else
'5 Demon Hearts => Constitution Potion
			If HasObj(Player, 285) >= 5 Then
				TakeObj(Player, 285, 5)
				GiveObj(Player, 447, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 5 Demon Hearts into a Constitution Potion!", Yellow)
				Exit Function
			End If
		End If
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not have more than 2 Stat Potions.", Grey)
End If

End Function

function main(player as long) as long   
dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long

   GlobalMessage("Capture the Flag has started!", 9)
   B = 0
   C = 0
   For A = 1 to 10
      SpawnObject(70, 40, 1, A, 1)
      SpawnObject(78, 40, 1, A, 10)
   Next A
   For A = 1 to 10
      SpawnObject(70, 40, 1, A, 10)
      SpawnObject(78, 40, 1, A, 1)
   Next A
   For A = 1 to 80
      If GetPlayerMap(A) = 79 Then
       If A = Player | GetPlayerAccess(A) > 0 Then
          PlayerWarp(Player, 74, 3, 3)
       Else   
         D = Random(2)
         If D = 0 Then

	PlayerWarp(Killed, 82, 5, 1)

			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then

			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
		If Count = 0 Then
			GlobalMessage("Jailbreak!", Yellow)
			OpenDoor(84, 10, 2)
		End If
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

PlayerWarp(Player, 70, 2, 6)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then	'Red Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 508) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Red Flag has been taken! You must return it!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If HasObj(Player, 509) Then	'Has Blue Flag
		RunScript1("CTFRedScore", Player)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "This is your Flag.", White)
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 2 Then	'Blue Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 508) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Red Flag has been taken!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If RunScript1("Invent", Player) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Your inventory is full.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has picked up the Red Flag!"), BrightBlue)
	GiveObj(Player, 508, 1)
	SetFlag(181, 0)
	Timer(Player, 2, "FlagTimer")
	For Loop = 0 To 80
		If GetObjNum(70, Loop) = 508 Then DestroyObject(70, Loop)
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

Function Main(Player As Long) As Long
	Dim A as Long
	'Reset Flags
	RunScript1("ResetFlags", Player)

	If StrCmp(GetMapName(GetPlayerMap(Player)), "") Then PlayerWarp(Player, 1, 5, 5)

	'Player God MOTD
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 78) > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are a helper god.  Available commands are warpto <player>, boot <player> <reason>, ban <player> <reason>, squelch <player> <time>, and jail <player> <time>.", WHITE)
	End If

	'New Player
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 10 Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 677, 2, 2)
		CalculateStats(Player)
		SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerMaxHP(Player))
		SetPlayerStatus(Player, 2)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Welcome to Odyssey!  To move about, use the arrow keys.  To run, hold shift while moving.  Head downward to embark on your adventure!", BRIGHTGREEN)
	End If
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 25 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Make sure to check the website at www.odysseyclassic.com for extra help.", Yellow)
	End If

	TakeObj(Player, 510, HasObj(Player, 510)) 'Old Incognito
	TakeObj(Player, 497, HasObj(Player, 497)) 'CTF Name Change
	TakeObj(Player, 362, HasObj(Player, 362)) 'Dodgeball
	TakeObj(Player, 383, HasObj(Player, 383)) 'Snowtossers
	TakeObj(Player, 508, HasObj(Player, 508)) 'Red Flag
	TakeObj(Player, 509, HasObj(Player, 509)) 'Blue Flag

	'------- Bug Fix? -------
	If StrCmp(GetPlayerName(Player), "") Then SetPlayerName(Player, "Bugged")

	RunScript1("Sprite", Player)
	RunScript1("Orders", Player)
	'RunScript1("ResetPots", Player)

	'Artifacts
		If HasObj(Player, 393) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)
		If HasObj(Player, 389) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)

	'If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 80 & GetPlayerAccess(Player) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Player, 666, 5, 5)
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 31) > 0 Then RunScript1("Poison1", Player)

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 40) > 0 Then PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 40)), " minutes left to serve.")), White)

	Main = Continue
End Function

Function Main(Player as Long, Message as String) AS LONG

If GetPlayerLevel(Player) >= 30 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 0 Then
		If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Of course, how can I help?''", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Thank you kind sir. Recently I came across some quite interesting treasures, but this one piece has had me puzzled. Would you like to see?''", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Im always interested in treasure.", DarkGrey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. I dont think you should be giving me valuables...", DarkGrey)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 1)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Im a very busy adventurer, leave me be.''", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Oh, sorry to bother you.''", Yellow)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 1 Then
		If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Im always interested in treasure.''", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Here it is. Strange isnt it. I havent the faintest idea what it says. Luckily my good friend Cundi is a dab hand at deceiphering old languages, would you mind taking it to him?''", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Sure thing, where can I find him?", DarkGrey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. On second thoughts, maybe Im not the one to do this.", DarkGrey)
			GiveObj(Player, 280, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 2)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I dont think you should be giving me valuables...''", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Maybe I'll reconsider.''", Yellow)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 0)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 2 Then
		If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Sure thing, where can I find him?''", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Oh thank you! He lives in the highest part of the world, a grand magician of the name Cundi. Farewell''", Yellow)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 3)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		End If
		If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''On second thoughts, maybe Im not the one to do this.''", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Then I'll be having that back thank you.''", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 280, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 0)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 3 Then
		If HasObj(Player, 280) = 0 Then
			If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Eh, yes please...''", Grey)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Here you go, try to be more careful this time.''", Yellow)
				GiveObj(Player, 280, 1)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
			If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Its ok, I have it in a safe place.''", Grey)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Fine, but please hurry.''", Yellow)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		End If
	End If
End If

Main = Continue
End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long, Damage as Long, Cast as Long
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = 1
Damage = Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 10)

If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "KIXFACE!", BrightGreen)


For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If Player <> Loop Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 3 & CalcY < 3 Then
				Cast = 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 31, Damage)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 33, Player)
				CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 18, 40, 2, 2, 0)
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has poisoned you!"), White)
				Timer(Loop, 2, "Poison1")
				Timer(Loop, 20, "PoisonCooldown")
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Cast = 1 Then SetPlayerFlag(Player, 32, 1)

End Sub

Function Main(Killer AS LONG, Killed as LONG) as LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Killed)
X = GetPlayerX(Killed)
Y = GetPlayerY(Killed)

	'Poison
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 31) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 31, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 33, 0)
	End If

	'God Death
	If GetPlayerAccess(Killed) > 0 Then
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	'Cleric Spell - Redemption
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 207) > 0 Then RunScript1("redemption2", Killed)

	'Minigames
	Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10)
		Case 1 'Carn
			RunScript2("carnkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 2 'Team Carn
			RunScript2("teamkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 3 'Battle
			RunScript2("battlekill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 4 'TTD
			RunScript2("ttdkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 6 'Big CTF
			RunScript2("ctfkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 11 'Football
			RunScript2("footballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 12 'Dodgeball
			RunScript2("dodgeballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 13 'Team Arena
			RunScript2("teamarenakill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 14 'Tournament Kill
			RunScript2("tournamentkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
		Case 16 'Snowball Tag
			RunScript2("snowballkill", Killer, Killed)
			Main = Stop
			Exit Function
	End Select

	'Hell
	If GetPlayerMap(Killed) = 666 Then
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	'Stake Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 13) = 3 Then
		RunScript2("stakekill", Killer, Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	'Duel Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 14) > 0 Then
		RunScript2("duelkill", Killer, Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If GetPlayerMap(Killer) = 1988 | GetPlayerMap(Killer) = 1987 Then
		PlayerWarp(Killed, 1988, 6, 3)
		RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

	If HasObj(Killed, 393) Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Killer) > 0 Then
			If RunScript1("Invent", Killer) = 1 Then
				RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
			Else
				If HasObj(Killer, 389) | HasObj(Killer, 393) Then
					RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
				Else
					TakeObj(Killed, 393, HasObj(Killed, 393))
					GiveObj(Killer, 393, 1)
					GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " takes the Babylon Torch!"), Yellow)
				End If
			End If
		Else
			RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
		End If
	End If
	If HasObj(Killed, 389) Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Killer) > 0 Then
			If RunScript1("Invent", Killer) = 1 Then
				RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
			Else
				If HasObj(Killer, 389) | HasObj(Killer, 393) Then
					RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
				Else
					TakeObj(Killed, 389, HasObj(Killed, 389))
					GiveObj(Killer, 389, 1)
					GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " takes the Dragonia Candle!"), Yellow)
				End If
			End If
		Else
			RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Killed)
		End If
	End If

	'Prevent being warped to town when killed in the arena
	Select Case GetPlayerMap(Killed)
		Case 1887 'Gallins House
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 30, 2)
		Case 1962 'House of PK
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 30, 1)
		Case Else
			SpawnObject(Map, 443, 1, X, Y)	'First Aid Kits
	End Select
	
	SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 15, 1)

	Main = Continue
End Function

Function Main(Player as Long, Target as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long

	PlayerMessage(Player, GetPlayerName(Target), Yellow)
For Loop = 1 To 20
	PlayerMessage(Player, GetObjectName(GetPlayerInvObject(Target, Loop)), White)
Next Loop

	PlayerMessage(Player, "Equipped", Yellow)
For Loop = 1 To 5
	PlayerMessage(Player, GetObjectName(GetPlayerEquipped(Target, Loop)), White)
Next Loop
PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("HP: ", str(GetPlayerHP(Target))), Green)
PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Energy: ", str(GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Target))), Green)
End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long
Ration = HasObj(Player, 445) + HasObj(Player, 446) + HasObj(Player, 447) + HasObj(Player, 449)

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
	If A = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to create potions.", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If

If Ration < 3 Then
'20 Scorpian Stings => Strength Potion
	If HasObj(Player, 403) & HasObj(Player, 286) >= 10 & HasObj(Player, 78) >= 20 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 78, 20)
		TakeObj(Player, 403, 1)
		TakeObj(Player, 286, 10)
		GiveObj(Player, 445, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've made a Vial of Water, 10 Hell Shards and 20 Scorpian Stings into a Strength Potion!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have all the ingredients required.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not carry more than 3 Stat Potions.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Source:
Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

For A = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(A, 10) = 1 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 0)
			PlayerWarp(A, 677, 5, 5)
			BootPlayer(A, "Left Guild in CTF")
		End If
	End If
Next A

'Spectator
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 30 & GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 31 Then
	Exit Function
End If

'RedTeam
If getplayerguild(player) = 30 then
	exit function
end if

'BlueTeam
If getplayerguild(player) = 31 then
If hasobj(player,508) then		'Has Red Flag

For A = 0 to getmaxusers
	If HasObj(A, 509) Then		'Blue Flag Gone
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must recover your flag first!", 15)
		exit function
	end if
Next A

'Blue Score
setflag(63,getflag(63)+1)
globalmessage(strcat(getplayername(player), " has scored for the Blue Team!"),white)
globalmessage(strcat("<Score> Red Team: ", strcat(str(getflag(62)),strcat(" Blue Team: ",strcat(str(getflag(63)), " <Score>")))),yellow)
takeobj(player,508,1)
setplayerstatus(player,0)
setPlayerSprite(Player, 133)
ResetMap(124)
ResetMap(149)
ResetMap(150)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
	If GetPlayerMap(A) = 124 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 149 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 150 Then
		takeobj(a,509,1)
		SetPlayerStatus(a, 0)
		SetPlayerHP(a, GetPlayerMaxHP(a))
		SetPlayerEnergy(a, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(a))
		SetPlayerMana(a, GetPlayerMaxMana(a))
			if getplayerguild(a) = 31 then
				playerwarp(a,124,8,6)
				setPlayerSprite(a, 133)
			End If
			if getplayerguild(a) = 30 then
				playerwarp(a,150,3,6)
				setPlayerSprite(a, 132)
			End If
	End If
next a

'Blue Team Wins
if getflag(63) = 5 then
 globalmessage("The Blue Team has won Capture the Flag!",brightGreen)
 setflag(62,0)
 setflag(63,0)
      
      for a = 0 to getmaxusers
		if getplayermap(a) = 124 | getplayermap(a) = 149 | getplayermap(a) = 150 then
			if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
				If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then GiveObj(A, 504, 1)
				SetPlayerStatus(A,0)
				SetPlayerSprite(A,0)
				SetPlayerGuild(A, GetPlayerFlag(A, 5))
				Playerwarp(A, 677,5,5)	
			end if
		end if 
      next a
      Exit Function
end if

'Spawn Flags
SpawnObject(150, 508, 1, 1, 6)
SpawnObject(124, 509, 1, 10, 6)
exit function

else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 124, 9, 6)
	exit function
end if
end if

End Function

Sub Main()
	Dim Hour as Long, Minute as Long, Loop as Long 

	SetFlag(94, GetFlag(94) + 1)								'Minute Timer
	If GetFlag(94) % 60 = 0 Then SetFlag(98, GetFlag(98) + 1)	'Hour Timer

	'1 Minute
	RunScript0("LightTimer")
	RunScript0("JailTimer")
	RunScript0("Artifacts")
	'Lavos
	RunScript0("LavosTimer")
	'Fort
	Runscript0("FortTimer")
	'AB Boss
	Runscript0("ABtimer")


	'Fort 1a (test)
	'dim d as long
	'for d = 1 to getmaxusers()
	'if getplayerflag(d,184) > 10 then
	'setplayerflag(d,184,0)

	'else
	'if getplayerflag(d,184) > 0 then
	'setplayerflag(d, 184, getplayerflag(d,184)+1)
	'end if
	'end if

	'next d

	'Fort 1b
	if getflag(185) > 180 then
		setflag(185,0)
		setflag(186,0)
	else
		if getflag(185) > 0 then
			setflag(185, getflag(185)+1)
		end if
	end if


	'fortvault
	If getflag(187) > 0 Then
		Setflag(187, getflag(187) - 1)
	end if

	'vault
	If GetFlag(188) > 0 Then 'Fort Reward Timer
		If GetMapPlayerCount(2119) = 0 then
			setflag(188, 0)
			setflag(187, 100)
		End if
	end if

	If GetFlag(85) > 0 Then RunScript0("TofTimer")
	If GetFlag(89) > 0 Then RunScript0("ChampTimer")
	If GetFlag(99) > 0 Then RunScript0("FootballTimer")
	If GetFlag(82) = 1 Then GlobalMessage("Carnage will begin shortly, type /carn for a instant warp to the waiting room!  You do not lose items or experience in a carnage battle.", BrightBlue)
	If GetFlag(145) > 0 Then
		If GetFlag(146) = 0 Then
			RunScript0("SancGame2End")
		Else
			SetFlag(146, GetFlag(146) - 1)
			If GetFlag(146) = 0 Then MapMessage(620, "One Minute Left!", Yellow)
		End If
	End If

	'5 Minutes
	If GetFlag(94) % 5 = 0 Then
		If GetFlag(80) > 0 Then GlobalMessage("Tournament Arena is currently open. Type /tourny to join.", Yellow)
		If GetFlag(85) > 0 Then GlobalMessage("ToF is currently open. Type /tof to join.", Yellow)
		If GetFlag(89) > 10 Then GlobalMessage("Solo the Champ is currently open. Type /champ to join.", Yellow)
		If GetFlag(122) > 0 Then GlobalMessage(strcat("The Odyssey Lottery is now open! Type /lottery with ", strcat(str(GetFlag(124)), " Gold to play!")), BrightGreen)
	End If

	'60 Minutes
	If GetFlag(94) % 60 = 10 Then
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Loop)
		Next Loop
	End If
	'If GetFlag(94) % 60 = 25 Then RunScript0("Average")
	'If GetFlag(94) % 60 = 40 Then RunScript0("Guilds")
	'If GetFlag(94) % 60 = 55 Then RunScript0("Average")

	'7 Hours
	If GetFlag(98) % 7 = 0 & GetFlag(94) % 60 = 0 Then
		If GetFlag(89) = 0 Then RunScript0("ChampHost")  
	End If
	
	RunScript0("BlockerCheck")
	'RunScript1("DuckAttack", 79)
End Sub

else

spawnobject(getplayermap(player),6,1,x,y)

case else
mapmessage(getplayermap(player),"Case Else",white)

end select

main = continue
End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) as Long
dim A as Long, X as Long, Y as Long

A = Random(30) + 1
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Up Then Y = Y - 1 
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Down Then Y = Y + 1 
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Left Then X = X - 1
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Right Then X = X + 1

Select Case A
	Case 1
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a Perfect Diamond!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 434, 1, X, Y)
	Case 2
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a Shining Ruby!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 435, 1, X, Y)
	Case 3

	Case 4
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a Bright Sapphire!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 438, 1, X, Y)
	Case 5
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a Shined Amethyst!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 458, 1, X, Y)
	Case 6
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a pile of gold!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 6, 700, X, Y)
	Case 7
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a big pile of gold!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 6, 1000, X, Y)
	Case 8
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a small pile of gold!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 6, 400, X, Y)
	Case 9
		MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), "The raider drops a huge pile of gold!", White)
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 6, 2500, X, Y)
End Select

Main = Continue

End Function

		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Im a very busy adventurer, leave me be.", DarkGrey)
		Exit Function
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 3 Then
		If HasObj(Player, 280) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''How's the trip coming along? You haven't gotten far have you...''", Yellow)
		Exit Function
		End If
		If HasObj(Player, 280) = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''YOU LOST IT!?!? Good thing I knew you'd do that. Would you like another copy?", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Eh, yes please...", DarkGrey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Its ok, I have it in a safe place.", DarkGrey)
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 4 Then
		If HasObj(Player, 281) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''You made it!! Thank you so much adventurer! I don't know how to repay you, all these rubies wouldn't be enough, but I'm sure the deed is reward in itself for you.''", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''...''", Grey)
			TakeObj(Player, 281, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 5)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You have completed the Gibberish Errand!", BrightGreen)
				If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You have gained 20k experience!", Green)
				Else
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 100000)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You have received 100k Gold Coins!", Green)
				End If
			Exit Function
		End If
		If HasObj(Player, 281) = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''You met Cundi? But you lost the translation... Good game newb, go get another one.''", Yellow)
			Exit Function
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) > 4 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Welcome to Ness's Ruby Centre, bank of Dragonia''", Grey)	
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Ness Atoui says, ''Welcome to Ness's Ruby Centre, bank of Dragonia''", Grey)
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Cost1 as Long, Cost2 as Long, Cost3 as Long, Cost4 as Long
dim Cost5 as Long, Cost6 as Long, Cost7 as Long

Cost1 = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(130), 400) 'Lumber
Cost2 = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(131), 400) 'Coarse Ore
Cost3 = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(132), 160) 'Flawed Ore
Cost4 = 1000 - Divide(GetFlag(133), 20) 'Pure Ore
Cost5 = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(134), 400) 'Small Fish
Cost6 = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(135), 160) 'Medium Fish
Cost7 = 1000 - Divide(GetFlag(136), 20) 'Big Fish
If Cost1 < 75 Then Cost1 = 75
If Cost2 < 75 Then Cost2 = 75
If Cost3 < 150 Then Cost3 = 150
If Cost4 < 500 Then Cost4 = 500
If Cost5 < 75 Then Cost5 = 75
If Cost6 < 150 Then Cost6 = 150
If Cost7 < 500 Then Cost7 = 500

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Skills Market==", Yellow)

PlayerMessage(Player, "/market buy <Item Number> <Ammount>", DarkGrey)
PlayerMessage(Player, "/market sell <Item Number> <Ammount>", DarkGrey)

End Sub

Sub Main()

dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Item as Long, Value as Long

Map = 1799

For Item = 0 To 50
	For X = 1 To 2
		For Y = 5 To 6
			If GetObjX(Map, Item) = X & GetObjY(Map, Item) = Y Then
				Value = GetObjVal(Map, Item)
				SpawnObject(Map, GetObjNum(Map, Item), Value, X+3, Y-5)
				DestroyObject(Map, Item)
				GoTo NextItem
			End If
		Next Y
	Next X
	For X = 9 To 10
		For Y = 5 To 6
			If GetObjX(Map, Item) = X & GetObjY(Map, Item) = Y Then
				Value = GetObjVal(Map, Item)
				SpawnObject(Map, GetObjNum(Map, Item), Value, X-3, Y-5)
				DestroyObject(Map, Item)
				GoTo NextItem
			End If
		Next Y
	Next X
NextItem:
Next Item

End Sub

Name: disguise
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Mana as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = 40

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be guilded to use this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If HasObj(Player, 407) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require Blinding Powder to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 27) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Eva Nescent!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 27, 1)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
TakeObj(Player, 407, 1)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Loop))
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Loop))
				SetPlayerSprite(Loop, GetGuildSprite(GetPlayerGuild(Loop)))
				SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25, 1)
				Timer(Loop, 10, "TurnVisible3")
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Name: mulecheck
Source:
Sub Main(Player AS LONG)
	Dim A AS LONG, B As LONG
	Dim DupeCount AS LONG
	
	For A = 1 to 80
		SetPlayerFlag(A, 256, 0)
	Next A
	
	For A = 1 to 80
		If IsPlaying(A) Then
			For B = 1 to 80
				If IsPlaying(B) Then
					If A = B Then
					
					Else
						If StrCmp(GetPlayerIP(A), GetPlayerIP(B)) Then
							If GetPlayerFlag(B, 256) = 0 Then
								SetPlayerFlag(A, 256, 1)
								SetPlayerFlag(B, 256, 1)
								DupeCount = DupeCount + 1
								PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(A), " - "), GetPlayerName(B)), WHITE)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			Next B
		End If
	Next A
	
	PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat("Total dupes: ", Str(DupeCount)), WHITE)
	
	For A = 1 to 80
		SetPlayerFlag(A, 256, 0)
	Next A
End Sub

Name: babcook
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) & HasObj(Player, 69) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Small Fish to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long

If GetFlag(141) > 0 Then
	Select Case Random(9)
	Case 0
		X = 2
		Y = 2
		SetFlag(140, 1)
	Case 1
		X = 8
		Y = 2
		SetFlag(140, 2)
	Case 2
		X = 5
		Y = 3
		SetFlag(140, 3)
	Case 3
		X = 10
		Y = 4
		SetFlag(140, 4)
	Case 4
		X = 4
		Y = 5
		SetFlag(140, 5)
	Case 5
		X = 2
		Y = 6
		SetFlag(140, 6)
	Case 6
		X = 8
		Y = 6
		SetFlag(140, 7)
	Case 7
		X = 4
		Y = 8
		SetFlag(140, 8)
	Case 8
		X = 7
		Y = 9
		SetFlag(140, 9)
	End Select
		CreateTileEffect(1409, X, Y, 1, 40, 8, 0, 0)
		SetFlag(141, GetFlag(141) - 1)
		Timer(Player, 1, "Floor")
End If

End Sub

Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) < 2 Then PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''The furance can smelt your ores, then type /smith to see what I can make.''", White)
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''How can I help you adventurer.''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I am in need of some Metal Bands for a bucket. Madargan said you'd still have the diamentions from last time.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. How do I made Smelted Metal?", DarkGrey)
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 3 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 221) >= 3 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Ahh you brought the Smelted Metal. Hold on while I shape them into Metals Bands for you.''", Yellow)
		TakeObj(Player, 221, 3)
		GiveObj(Player, 461, 2)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Take these to Madargan Gar the Northcoast Crafter.''", Yellow)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 4)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Did you get that Smelted Metal yet?''", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I'll have the Smelted Metal ready soon.", DarkGrey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. How do I make Smelted Metal?", DarkGrey)
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 4 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Did you take those Metal Bands to Madargan Gar?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Where does he live again?", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. I lost those Metal Bands...", DarkGrey)
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

SetFlag(82, 0)
SetFlag(141, 0) 'Red Count
SetFlag(142, 0) 'Blue Count
SetFlag(143, 5) 'Red Kills
SetFlag(144, 5) 'Blue Kills

GlobalMessage("Dodgeball has started!", BrightGreen)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 | GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 78) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1427, 5, 11)
			Else
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 12)
				If GetFlag(141) <= GetFlag(142) Then
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1427, 5, 0)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 3)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 1)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					SetFlag(141, GetFlag(141) + 1)
				Else
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1427, 6, 11)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 4)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 7)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
					SetFlag(142, GetFlag(142) + 1)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Name: dodgeballwin
Source:
Sub Main()
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 12 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count1 = Count1 + 1
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Count2 = Count2 + 1
	End If
Next Loop

If Count1 = 0 & GetFlag(143) = 0 Then	'Red Lose
	GlobalMessage("Blue Team has won Dodgeball!", BrightBlue)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 12 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 | GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 4 Then GiveObj(Loop, 483, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
		End If
		While HasObj(Loop, 362)
			TakeObj(Loop, 362, 1)
		Wend
	Next Loop
	ResetMap(1427)
End If
If Count2 = 0 & GetFlag(144) = 0 Then	'Blue Lose
	GlobalMessage("Red Team has won Dodgeball!", BrightRed)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 12 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 | GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 3 Then GiveObj(Loop, 483, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
		End If
		While HasObj(Loop, 362)
			TakeObj(Loop, 362, 1)
		Wend
	Next Loop
	ResetMap(1427)
End If

End Sub

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG
   Dim MyMap as Long
   Dim MyX as Long
   Dim MyY as Long
   Dim UsedAdvocate as Long
   MyMap = GetPlayerMap(Player)
   MyX = GetPlayerX(Player)
   MyY = GetPlayerY(Player)

   Dim A as Long
   For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
      If GetPlayerMap(A) = MyMap Then
         Dim DistX as Long, DistY as Long
         DistX = Abs(MyX - GetPlayerX(A))
         DistY = Abs(MyY - GetPlayerY(A))

         If DistX <= 1 & DistY <= 1 Then
            If Player = A Then
               'Do Nothing
            Else
               UsedAdvocate = 1
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
               AttackPlayer(Player, A, 255)
            End If
         End If   
      End If
   Next A

   If UsedAdvocate = 1 Then 
      GlobalMessage(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has used a Death's Advocate!"), BRIGHTGREEN)
      TakeObj(Player, 455, 1)
   End If

   Main = Continue
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG) AS LONG
	TakeObj(Player, 485, 1)
   Main = Stop
   
   Exit Function

   Dim A as Long, B as Long, C as Long, D as Long, E as Long
   Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
      Case UP
         A = GetPlayerX(Player)
         B = GetPlayerY(Player) - 1
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = B - 1
         If B < 0 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, A, E) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, A, E)
            End If
         Next A
      Case DOWN
         A = GetPlayerX(Player)
         B = GetPlayerY(Player) + 1
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = B + 1
         If B > 10 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, A, E) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, A, E)
            End If
         Next A
      Case LEFT
         A = GetPlayerX(Player) - 1
         B = GetPlayerY(Player)
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = A - 1
         If A < 0 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, E, B) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, E, B)
            End If
         Next A
      Case RIGHT
         A = GetPlayerX(Player) + 1
         B = GetPlayerY(Player)
         D = GetPlayerMap(Player)
         E = A + 1
         If A > 10 Then Exit Function
         For C = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
            If GetPlayerMap(C) = D & GetPlayerX(C) = A & GetPlayerY(C) = B Then
               If GetTileAtt(D, E, B) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(C, D, E, B)
            End If
         Next A
   End Select
END FUNCTION

 dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long

    if c = 0 then
     for b = 0 to 6

    for v = 0 to 2

     next x

    end if

    next v
  end if
 end if
'end if
  next a
 else
  playermessage(player,"You aren't a god!",yellow)
 end if
end sub

Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
RunScript1("Sprite", Killed)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 1 Then
			Count = Count + 1
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Count = 1 Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " and won Carnage!")), BrightGreen)
	RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
	RunScript1("GameWarp", Killer)
	GiveObj(Killer, 484, 1)
	SetPlayerFlag(Killer, 10, 0)
	SetPlayerGuild(Killer, GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 5))
	RunScript1("Sprite", Killer)
Else
	GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " in Carnage!")), BrightRed)
End If

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS Long
dim Loop as Long, WinNum as Long, Rake as Long

If GetFlag(122) > 0 Then
	WinNum = Random(GetFlag(120)) + 1
	Rake = Divide(GetFlag(121), 10)

				GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), strcat(" wins the pot of ", strcat(str(GetFlag(121)), "!!"))), BrightGreen)
				GiveObj(Loop, 6, GetFlag(121))
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220, 0)
				SetFlag(120, 0)
				SetFlag(121, 0)
				SetFlag(122, 0)
				RunScript1("JACKPOT", Player)
				Goto EndLoop
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
EndLoop:
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The Lottery is not open.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player AS LONG)

	Dim Dir AS LONG, DestDir AS LONG
	Dim Map AS LONG, StartX AS LONG, StartY AS LONG
	Dim CheckX AS LONG, CheckY AS LONG
	Dim DestX AS LONG, DestY AS LONG
	Dim Damage AS LONG, Mana AS LONG
	
	Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
	StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Dir = GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Mana = 1
	Select Case Dir
		Case 0 'Up
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY - 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY - 1
			DestDir = 1
		Case 1 'Down
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY + 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY + 1
			DestDir = 0
		Case 2 'Left
			CheckX = StartX - 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX - 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 3
		Case 3 'Right
			CheckX = StartX + 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX + 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 2
	End Select
	
	'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
	If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If HasObj(Player, 298) = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You lack a required item.", Grey)

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Cundi says, ''Hey there how can I help you. Potions, rings? Anything you need is right here. I am also well diverse in most languages, if you need help to clarify something, I'll be glad to do it.''", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 3 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 280) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Cundi says, ''Ahh you've brought me an ancient text! Good job child, I'll get to work translating it for you now.''", Yellow)
		TakeObj(Player, 280, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "...", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "...", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Cundi says, ''Here you go, you may understand this a little better. Send Ness my regards!''", Yellow)
		GiveObj(Player, 281, 1)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 92, 4)
		Exit Function
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Cundi says, ''What's that? You had something for me? But you don't have it now? Well thats not very helpful is it.", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) = 4 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 281) = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Cundi says, ''You've lost it haven't you... *sighs* Good thing I always keep copies.''", Yellow)
		GiveObj(Player, 281, 1)
		Exit Function
	End If
	If HasObj(Player, 281) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Cundi says, ''You better hurry back to Ness with that. He'll be eager to read it.''", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 92) > 4 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Cundi says, ''Hey there how can I help you. Potions, rings? Anything you need is right here. I am also well diverse in most languages, if you need help to clarify something, I'll be glad to do it.''", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name: summonerfire2

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Monster as Long
dim RangeX as Long, RangeY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
If Map <> 1489 Then Exit Function
If GetFlag(93) > 1 Then Exit Function
X = GetMonsterX(1489, 0) - 1
Y = GetMonsterY(1489, 0) - 1

For RangeX = 0 To 2
	For RangeY = 0 To 2
		CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 40, 30 + Random(20), 8, 0, 0)
			If GetPlayerX(Player) = X & GetPlayerY(Player) = Y Then
				MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Player, 42)
			End If
			For Monster = 1 To 5
				If GetMonsterX(1489, Monster) = X & GetMonsterY(1489, Monster) = Y Then
					AttackMonster(Player, Monster, 10)
				End If
			Next Monster
		Y = Y + 1
	Next RangeY
	X = X + 1
	Y = GetMonsterY(1489, 0) - 1
Next RangeX

SetFlag(92, GetFlag(92) + 1)
RunScript1("summonerfire", Player)

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Message as String

GlobalMessage("==Titan Takedown Teams==", White)
Message = "Invaders - "
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then
			Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
GlobalMessage(Message, Red)
Message = "Titans - "
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then
			Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
GlobalMessage(Message, Yellow)
End Sub

CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 50, 80, 8, 0, 0)

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Chance as Long, Map as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

PlayerMessage(Player, "You open your present and...!", White)
TakeObj(Player, 484, 1)

	Case 0

End Select

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "!!", BrightGreen)
CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 45, 40, 8, 0, 0)

End Sub

SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
dim a as long
a = getplayerlevel(player) * 200
if hasobj(player,405) = 0 then
If HasObj(Player, 6) >= a & hasobj(player, 413) >= 20 & hasobj(player, 9) >= 1 then 
TakeObj(Player, 6, a)
Takeobj(player, 413, 20)
Takeobj(player, 9, 1)
GiveObj(player, 405, 1)

     CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "!", BRIGHTGREEN)
     CreateCharacterEffect(getplayermap(player),player,27,1,7,2,5)
  else
     PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have the materials to form an Ankh!", grey)
  END IF
  else
  playermessage(player, "You already have an Ankh!", grey)
 end if
END SUB

playermessage(player,"On Tal von Ubel: Tal von Ubel (or, TvU) is something I started designing around December of '04. It was originally a great big bandit fort that had a fairly long quest to gain entrance to.",grey)

playermessage(player,"The original one was headed by ''Archdemon Baz'' (pronounced Boz), and he resided in a great big tower in the middle of the valley. (Yes, both actually ARE valleys of evil, surrounded by mountain and encased in lava, filled with demons.)",grey)
playermessage(player,"This Tal von Ubel is led by the great Demongod Kha'rg'arn'gour (Or Kha'rg, for short). Kha'rg resides in the Cave of Demons gods, in the center of the area. Initially, the Kha'rg fight would be an admin led event, with an admin actually playing as Kha'rg. Kha'rg has made several appearances outside of TvU, played by me, where he massacred.. well, most everyone.",grey)
playermessage(player,"I later decided though, it would be best for Kha'rg to just be a very challenging monster fight, in case I ever quit or wasn't able to get online. What makes the fight so challenging is that there are around 8 or 9 scripts running during the fight.",grey)

(Yes, both actually ARE valleys of evil, surrounded by mountain and encased in lava, filled with demons.)k��This Tal von Ubel is led by the great Demongod Kha'rg'arn'gour (Or Kha'rg, for short). Kha'rg resides in the Cave of Demons gods, in the center of the area. Initially, the Kha'rg fight would be an admin led event, with an admin actually playing as Kha'rg. Kha'rg has made several appearances outside of TvU, played by me, where he massacred.. well, most everyone.ø���I later decided though, it would be best for Kha'rg to just be a very challenging monster fight, in case I ever quit or wasn't able to get online. What makes the fight so challenging is that there are around 8 or 9 scripts running during the fight.

sub main(player as long)
dim b as long, dmg as long, map as long, x as long, y as long, players as long, a as long, damage as long, check as long, speed as long, totalframes as long, loopcount as long, sprite as long, i as long


if GetPlayerMana(Player) >= 34 then
   PlayCustomWav(Player, 0)
   SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - 34)
   PlayerMessage(Player, "You cast Frost Wave.", grey)
   map = getplayermap(player)
   dmg= 30
x = getplayerx(player)
y = getplayery(player)
sprite = 51
speed = 1
totalframes = 3
loopcount = 0
totalframes = 7
x = getplayerx(player)
y = getplayery(player)
for i = 0 to 4
if GetTileAtt(getplayermap(player), x, y)=0 | GetTileAtt(getplayermap(player), x, y)=10 then
if getplayerdirection(player)=0 then y = y - 1
if getplayerdirection(player)=1 then y = y + 1
if getplayerdirection(player)=2 then x = x - 1
if getplayerdirection(player)=3 then x = x + 1
For B = 0 to 7
if CanAttackMonster(player,b) then
if getmonsterx(map,b)= x then
if getmonstery(map,b)=y then
AttackMonster(player,b,dmg)
end if
end if
end if
next B
end if
for players = 0 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(players)=map then
if getplayerx(players)=x then 
if getplayery(players)=y then
if player <> players then

AttackPlayer(Player,players,dmg) 
end if
end if
end if
end if
next players
outss:
next i
map = getplayermap(player)
x = getplayerx(player)
y = getplayery(player)
for i = 0 to 5
if GetTileAtt(getplayermap(player), x, y) = 0 & GetTileAtt(getplayermap(player), x, y) = 10 then
CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 1, 1, 8, LoopCount, 0)
goto outs
end if
if x=13 then
CreateTileEffect(Map, X-1, Y, 1, 1, 8, LoopCount, 0)
goto outs
end if
if y=13 then
CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y-1, 1, 1, 8, LoopCount, 0)
goto outs
end if
if x=-1 then
CreateTileEffect(Map, X+1, Y, 1, 1, 8, LoopCount, 0)
goto outs
end if
if y=-1 then
CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y+1, 1, 1, 8, LoopCount, 0)
goto outs
end if
CreateTileEffect(map,x,y, sprite, speed,8,loopcount,0)
if getplayerdirection(player)=0 then y = y - 1
if getplayerdirection(player)=1 then y = y + 1
if getplayerdirection(player)=2 then x = x - 1
if getplayerdirection(player)=3 then x = x + 1
next i
outs:
     else
        PlayerMessage(Player, "You have insufficient mana to cast this spell.", grey)
     END IF
end sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Chance as Long, LowChance as Long

Chance = Random(100) + 1
LowChance = Random(500) + 1
If Random(100) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "A Stone Golem grabs you and pulls you into the wall!", White)
'	SpawnMonster(1437, 194, 8, 6, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 210, GetPlayerMap(Player))
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 211, GetPlayerX(Player))
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 212, GetPlayerY(Player))
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1437, 5, 6)
End If
Select Case Chance
	Case 1
		'Amethyst
		GiveObj(Player, 82, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine an Amethyst!", Green)
	Case 2
		'Sapphire
		GiveObj(Player, 86, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Sapphire!", Green)
	Case 3
		'Emerald
		GiveObj(Player, 84, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine an Emerald!", Green)
	Case 4
		'Ruby
		GiveObj(Player, 85, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Ruby!", Green)
	Case 5
		'Diamond
		GiveObj(Player, 83, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Diamond!", Green)
	Case 6
		'Gold Nugget
		GiveObj(Player, 186, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Gold Nugget!", Green)
	Case Else
		Select Case LowChance
			Case 1
				'Perfect Diamond
				GiveObj(Player, 434, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Perfect Diamond!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 2
				'Shining Ruby
				GiveObj(Player, 435, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Shining Ruby!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 3
				'Clear Emerald
				GiveObj(Player, 441, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Clear Emerald!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 4
				'Bright Sapphire
				GiveObj(Player, 438, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Bright Sapphire!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 5
				'Shined Amethyst
				GiveObj(Player, 458, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine a Cut Amethyst!!", BrightGreen)
			Case 6
				'10 Gold Nuggets
				GiveObj(Player, 186, 10)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You mine 10 Gold Nuggets!!", BrightGreen)
		End Select
End Select

End Function

dim Chance as Long

	PlayerWarp(Player, 1438, 5, 9)

	End Select
End If

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Chance as Long, LowChance as Long

	PlayerMessage(Player, "A Water Sprite grabs your line and drags you under!", White)

Select Case Chance

		Case 0
			GiveObj(Player, 124, 1)

Select Case LowChance

Sub Main(Player as Long, Limit as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Team as Long

Start:
If Limit > 0 Then
	GlobalMessage("Let Battle Commence!", BrightRed)
	SetFlag(88, Limit)
	SetFlag(82, 0)
	SetFlag(86, 0)
	SetFlag(87, 0)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 | GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 78) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1420, 5, 0)
			Else
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 3)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
				SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 0)
				If Team = 0 Then
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 1)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1421, 0, 1)
					Team = 1
				Else
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 7)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1422, 11, 1)
					Team = 0
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

Else
	Limit = 30
	Goto Start
End If

End Sub

dim Health as Long
If HasObj(Player, 41) Then	'Candy Apple - 20hp

					TakeObj(Player, 149, 1)
					Health = 15
				Else
					If HasObj(Player, 329) Then	'Fish Cakes - 12hp

							If HasObj(Player, 48) Then	'Sushi - 6hp

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
Dim Mana as Long, Health as Long, Loop as Long
'Mage Spell - Leech HP

Mana = 40
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

'Att = GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y)
'Att2 = GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y)
'| Att = 5 | Att = 6 | Att = 8 | Att = 11 | Att = 13 | Att2 = 5 | Att2 = 6 | Att2 = 11 | Att2 = 13

If Map = 1423 | Map = 1424 | Map = 1425 | Map = 1826 | Map = 1949 | Map = 1828 | Map = 1829 | Map = 982 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit sub
End If



If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be Guilded to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Au Fero!", BrightGreen)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					Health = Divide(GetPlayerHP(Loop), 10)
					SetPlayerHP(Loop, GetPlayerHP(Loop) - Health)
					SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerHP(Player) + Health)
					If GetPlayerHP(Player) > GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerMaxHP(Player))
					CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 51, 40, 8, 0, 0)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Name: bomb2
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Damage as Long, Loop as Long

Map = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24)
X = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21)
Y = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22)
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Random(6)
If Damage < 10 Then Damage = 10

RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 1, 40, 8, 0, 0)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			If GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If Player = Loop Then
					SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerHP(Player) - Damage)
					CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, str(Damage), BrightRed)
				Else
					MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage - 10)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

End Sub

Name: tournament
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetFlag(80) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Tournament Arena is closed.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetMapIsFriendly(GetPlayerMap(Player)) = False Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be on a friendly map to warp to the Tournament Arena.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 5 | GetTileAtt2(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 5 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not warp to the Tournament Arena from vaults.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 210, GetPlayerMap(Player))
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 211, GetPlayerX(Player))
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 212, GetPlayerY(Player))
PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 5, 11)

End Sub
