Name: cookcrags
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) & HasObj(Player, 69) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Small Fish to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

Sub Main(Player as Long, Item as Long, Ammount as Long)
dim Cost as Long, Flag as Long

Select Case Item
	Case 1 'Lumber
		Item = 215
		Flag = 130
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 2 'Coarse Ore
		Item = 216
		Flag = 131
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 3 'Flawed Ore
		Item = 217
		Flag = 132
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 4 'Pure Ore
		Item = 218
		Flag = 133
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 20)
			If Cost < 750 Then Cost = 750
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 5 'Small Fish
		Item = 153
		Flag = 134
			Cost = 150 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 400)
			If Cost < 75 Then Cost = 75
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 6 'Medium Fish
		Item = 152
		Flag = 135
			Cost = 300 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 160)
			If Cost < 150 Then Cost = 150
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case 7 'Big Fish
		Item = 148
		Flag = 136
			Cost = 1500 - Divide(GetFlag(Flag), 20)
			If Cost < 750 Then Cost = 750
			Cost = Cost * Ammount
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must select which resource you would like to buy.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
End Select

If Ammount = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You must select how much ", strcat(GetObjectName(Item), " you wish to buy.")), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If Ammount > GetFlag(Flag) + 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("There is not that much ", strcat(GetObjectName(Item), " for sale.")), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If Ammount > 100 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may only buy in lots upto 100 items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

If Cost > HasObj(Player, 6) + 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You cannot afford that much ", GetObjectName(Item)), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
GiveObj(Player, Item, Ammount)
SetFlag(Flag, GetFlag(Flag) - Ammount)
PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have bought ", strcat(str(Ammount), strcat(" ", GetObjectName(Item)))), White)
RunScript0("refreshmarket")

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Strength as Long
''Stout Potion
Strength = 20

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 125) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerHP(Player) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
			TakeObj(Player, 447, 1)
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 124) = 0 Then
			CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, str(Divide(Strength, 2)), Brown)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 124, Strength)
			CalculateStats(Player)
			Timer(Player, 60, "Debuff")
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be full health to use this potion.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont want to drink that, it could be anything...", Grey)
End If

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Loop as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

If Map <> 1489 Then Exit Function
If GetFlag(93) > 2 Then Exit Function

For Loop = 1 To 2
	X = Random(4) + 3
	Y = Random(4) + 3

	SpawnMonster(Map, 235, X, Y, 0)
	CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 36, 40, 8, 0, 0)
Next Loop

For Loop = 0 To 5
	SetMonsterTarget(1489, Loop, Player)
Next Loop

PlayerMessage(Player, "The Summoner spawns minions from the ethreal world!", White)

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Flag as Long, Count as Long, Cost as Long
Cost = GetFlag(180)

If GetFlag(170) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "A Tournament is already in progress.", Grey)
'	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	RunScript1("GameWarp", Player)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetFlag(80) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The tournament arena is closed.", Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	Exit Sub
End If

If HasObj(Player, 6) < Cost Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You require ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to enter this Tournament.")), Grey)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)
	Exit Sub
End If

Count = 0
For Flag = 171 To 178
	If GetFlag(Flag) = 0 Then
		Select Case Flag
			Case 171
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 2, 6)
			Case 172
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 2, 8)
			Case 173
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 4, 6)
			Case 174
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 4, 8)
			Case 175
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 6, 6)
			Case 176
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 6, 8)
			Case 177
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 8, 6)
			Case 178
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, 8, 8)
		End Select
		SetFlag(Flag, Player)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 14)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 0)
		TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
		SetFlag(179, GetFlag(179) + Cost)
		GoTo EndLoop
	End If
Next Flag
PlayerWarp(Player, 1883, GetPlayerX(Player), 11)

EndLoop:
For Flag = 171 To 178
	If GetFlag(Flag) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
Next Flag

If Count = 8 Then
	MapMessage(1883, strcat("The Tournament Prize Pot is ", strcat(str(GetFlag(179)), " Gold!")), Yellow)
	RunScript0("TournamentRound1")
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long
'Cleric Redemption

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = 1

If HasObj(Player, 411) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Living Essence to cast this spell.", Grey)

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be below 20% health to cast this spell.", Grey)

	Exit Sub
End If

TakeObj(Player, 411, 1)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 207, 1)
PlayerMessage(Player, "You draw from the power of the essence.", White)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Loop as Long, Damage as Long
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 3)
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 207, 0)
If HasObj(Player, 411) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Living Essence to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

TakeObj(Player, 411, 1)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 15, 2)
CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Decerto!", BrightRed)
SetPlayerIsDead(Player, 0)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
		If Loop <> Player Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
				MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)
				CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 20, 40, 8, 0, 0)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
SetPlayerIsDead(Player, 1)

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long) AS LONG
dim Metal as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to smith.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

Metal = 448

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 174 Then
	Select Case Parm1
		Case 0
			PlayerMessage(Player, "=Smithing Menu=", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Soulbinders - 10 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Crown of Zeugg - 15 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Ztiwhborflail - 25 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Hero's Guard - 30 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "5. Repair Hero's Guard - 3 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, " - This will repair the first Hero's Guard to appear in your inventory, and will not repair any if equipped.", Grey)
'			PlayerMessage(Player, "smith # to smith an item", Grey)
		Case 1
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 10 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed some Soulbinders!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 10)
				GiveObj(Player, 117, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 2
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 15 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Crown of Zeugg!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 15)
				GiveObj(Player, 197, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 3
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 25 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Ztiwhborflail!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 25)
				GiveObj(Player, 250, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)

			End If
		Case 4
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 30 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Hero's Guard!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 30)
				GiveObj(Player, 248, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 5
			If HasObj(Player, 248) Then
				If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 3 Then
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You have repaired a Hero's Guard!", Yellow)
					TakeObj(Player, Metal, 3)
					RunScript1("repairheros", Player)
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to repair that.", Grey)
				End If
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have a Hero's Guard to repair.", Grey)
			End If
	End Select
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a blacksmiths to smith.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim RedCount as Long, BlueCount as Long, RedGate as Long, BlueGate as Long

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1443 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) <> 13 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot start a Team Battle.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "This is not the Team Arena.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then RedCount = RedCount + 1
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then BlueCount = BlueCount + 1
			X = GetPlayerX(Loop)
			Y = GetPlayerY(Loop)
			If Y = 1 Then
				If X = 0 | X = 1 Then RedGate = RedGate + 1
				If X = 10 | X = 11 Then BlueGate = BlueGate + 1
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If RedGate < 2 | BlueGate < 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "There are not enough players on the start tiles.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If

MapMessage(1443, strcat("A Team Battle has started - ", strcat(str(RedCount), strcat("v", str(BlueCount)))), Yellow)
SetFlag(153, 1)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 3 + Random(3), 1 + Random(3))
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 8 - Random(3), 6 - Random(3))
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main()
dim Loop as Long, RedCount as Long, BlueCount as Long

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
			Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11)
				Case 1
					RedCount = RedCount + 1
				Case 2
					BlueCount = BlueCount + 1
			End Select
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If RedCount = 0 Then
	MapMessage(1443, "Blue Team has Won!", BrightGreen)
	SetFlag(153, 0)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 6, 10)
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("You got ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)), " kills.")), White)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
				RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
				RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

If BlueCount = 0 Then
	MapMessage(1443, "Red Team has Won!", BrightGreen)
	SetFlag(153, 0)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 1443 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 13 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1443, 5, 10)
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("You got ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)), " kills.")), White)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
				RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
				RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

dim Colour as Long

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Quest Log==", Yellow)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 93) = 0 Then Colour = Red Else Colour = BrightGreen

PlayerMessage(Player, "-Manny Farmer", Colour)

PlayerMessage(Player, "-Sanctuary Wench", Colour)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 241) > 0 & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 241) < 6 Then Colour = Yellow

PlayerMessage(Player, "-Thelonious Monk", Colour)

			End If
		Exit Function
		End If
	Exit Function
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Alchemist says, ''Welcome back adventurer, how may I help you?''", Grey)
End If

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, Mon as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1828 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1829 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cant use that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to use this ability again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetTileAtt(Map, GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 11 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cant use that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
'If HasObj(Player, 413) = 0 Then
'	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Holy Water to use this ability.", Grey)
'	Exit Sub
'End If

	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
'	TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Mon En!", BrightGreen)
CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Player, 41, 40, 8, 0, 0)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case 0
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 1
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterY(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerY(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerX(Player) - GetMonsterX(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 2
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) <= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
	Case 3
		For Mon = 0 To 5
			If GetMonsterX(Map, Mon) >= GetPlayerX(Player) Then
				If Abs(GetPlayerY(Player) - GetMonsterY(Map, Mon)) < 4 Then
					If GetMonsterType(Map, Mon) <> 104 Then
						SetMonsterTarget(Map, Mon, Player)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Mon
End Select

End Sub

Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long

'Flag 86 = Red Score
'Flag 87 = Blue Score
'Flag 88 = Kill Limit

SetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 12) + 1)	'Player Scores

If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 1 Then	'Red Team Scores
	SetFlag(86, GetFlag(86) + 1)
	PlayerWarp(Killed, 1422, 11, 1)
	SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 7)
	SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 101)
	MapMessage(1420, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightRed)
	MapMessage(1421, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightRed)
	MapMessage(1422, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightRed)
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 2 Then	'Blue Team Scores
	SetFlag(87, GetFlag(87) + 1)
	PlayerWarp(Killed, 1421, 0, 1)
	SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 1)
	SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 100)
	MapMessage(1420, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightBlue)
	MapMessage(1421, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightBlue)
	MapMessage(1422, strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), strcat(" beats down ", GetPlayerName(Killed))), BrightBlue)
End If

RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
	
'Red Team Wins
If GetFlag(86) >= GetFlag(88) Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat("Red Team wins Battle Royale with ", strcat(str(GetFlag(86)), " kills!")), BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("Your score was ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)), " kills")), Yellow)
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			SetFlag(86, 0)
			SetFlag(87, 0)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If
'Blue Team Wins
If GetFlag(87) >= GetFlag(88) Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat("Blue Team wins Battle Royale with ", strcat(str(GetFlag(87)), " kills!")), BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("Your score was ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)), " kills")), Yellow)
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			SetFlag(86, 0)
			SetFlag(87, 0)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Function

Name: confuse

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
Dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
Dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long

Mana = 26
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) >= Mana Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
		RunScript1("cooldown", Player)
		SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
		CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Con Fun Dere!", BrightGreen)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
					If Loop <> Player Then
						CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
						CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
						If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
							If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 23) = 0 Then
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 23, 1)
								RunScript1("cooldown", Loop)
								PlayerMessage(Loop, "You become confused!", Grey)
								CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Loop, 21, 40, 8, 0, 0)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	End If
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Guilds as Long, Message as String
dim Count as Long, Colour as Long

GlobalMessage("==Guild List==", Yellow)
For Guilds = 1 To 29
	If GetGuildMemberCount(Guilds) > 0 Then
		Count = 0
		Message = strcat(GetGuildName(Guilds), " - ")
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = Guilds Then
					Count = Count + 1
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count > 0 Then
			If Colour = 4 Then Colour = 6 Else Colour = 4
			GlobalMessage(Message, Colour)
		End If
	End If
Next Guilds

End Sub

SUB Main(Player AS LONG)
Dim A as Long, B as Long, RedFlag as Long, BlueFlag as Long
RedFlag = 492
BlueFlag = 493
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 31 Then
   If HasObj(Player, RedFlag) Then
      For B = 1 to 80
         If HasObj(B, BlueFlag) Then
            PlayerMessage(Player, "You must recover your flag first!", 15)
            Exit Sub
         End If
      Next B
      TakeObj(Player, RedFlag, 1)
      SpawnObject(1552, RedFlag, 1, 0, 8)
      GlobalMessage(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " returned the Red Flag to the Blue Base.  Blue Team Wins!"), 11)
      GiveObj(Player, 504, 1)
      For A = 1 to 80
         If GetPlayerMap(A) = 1552 Then
               If HasObj(A, RedFlag) Then
                  TakeObj(A, RedFlag, 1)
                  SpawnObject(78, RedFlag, 1, 10, 5)
               End If
               PlayerWarp(A, 79, 5, 5)
               If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then GiveObj(A, 504, 1)
               If GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
                  SetPlayerGuild(A, 0)
                  SetPlayerSprite(A, 0)
                  SetPlayerStatus(A, 0)
               End If
         End If
      Next A
   Else
      PlayerWarp(Player, 78, 10, 7)
   End If
Else
   PlayerWarp(Player, 78, 10, 7)
End If
END SUB

      If BC = 1 Then

      If BC = 4 Then

      End If
      If BC = 5 Then

      End If

   If VALUA <> VALUB | VALUB <> VALUC | VALUC <> VALUA | VALUA <> VALUC | VALUC <> VALUB | VALUB <> VALUA Then
    playermessage(player, "You lose!", brown)
   End If

   If VALUA = 0 & VALUB = 0 & VALUC = 0 Then

else

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

PlayerWarp(Player, 78, 9, 6)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 2 Then	'Blue Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 509) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Blue Flag has been taken! You must return it!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If HasObj(Player, 508) Then	'Has Red Flag
		RunScript1("CTFBlueScore", Player)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "This is your Flag.", White)
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then	'Red Team
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If HasObj(Loop, 509) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The Blue Flag has been taken!", White)
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If RunScript1("Invent", Player) = 1 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Your inventory is full.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has picked up the Blue Flag!"), BrightRed)
	GiveObj(Player, 509, 1)
	Timer(Player, 2, "FlagTimer")
	SetFlag(182, 0)
	For Loop = 0 To 80
		If GetObjNum(78, Loop) = 509 Then DestroyObject(78, Loop)
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

Name: dragcook
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) >= 1 & HasObj(Player, 69) >= 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) >= 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Small Fish to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Name: winter
Source:
function main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long

globalmessage("A Random Team Carnage has started!",brightblue)
globalmessage("Map: Team Fortress Carnage",white)

b = 0
c = 0
d = 0
setflag(60,0)
setflag(61,0)


'//========Teams=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers

If getplayermap(a)= 68 then
if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
b = random(1)

if b = 0 then

if c >= d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 71)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 119)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
end if

else

if c < d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 119)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 71)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
end if

end if
else
end if
else
end if

next a

'//========Warp=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(A) = 68 then
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 30 Then PlayerWarp(A, 111, 0, 6)
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then PlayerWarp(A, 111, 11, 6)
 If GetPlayerAccess(A) > 5 Then PlayerWarp(A, 111, 1, 1)
end if

Name: craftsanc3
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to craft.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 594 Then
	Select Case Parm1
		Case 0
			PlayerMessage(Player, "=Crafting List=", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Odin's Shard - 2 Clear Emeralds, 1 Perfect Diamond", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Jewel of Fenrir - 2 Shining Rubys, 1 Perfect Diamond", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Gem of Valhalla - 2 Bright Sapphires, 1 Perfect Diamond", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Freya's Charm - 2 Cut Amethysts, 1 Perfect Diamond", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /craft # to craft an item.", White)
		Case 1
			If HasObj(Player, 441) >= 2 & HasObj(Player, 434) >= 1 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft an Odin's Shard!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, 441, 2)
				TakeObj(Player, 434, 1)
				GiveObj(Player, 59, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 2 Clear Emeralds and 1 Perfect Diamond to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 2
			If HasObj(Player, 435) >= 2 & HasObj(Player, 434) >= 1 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Jewel of Fenrir!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, 435, 2)
				TakeObj(Player, 434, 1)
				GiveObj(Player, 56, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 2 Shining Rubys and 1 Perfect Diamond to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 3
			If HasObj(Player, 438) >= 2 & HasObj(Player, 434) >= 1 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Gem of Valhalla!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, 438, 2)
				TakeObj(Player, 434, 1)
				GiveObj(Player, 53, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 2 Bright Sapphires and 1 Perfect Diamond to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 4
			If HasObj(Player, 458) >= 2 & HasObj(Player, 434) >= 1 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Freya's Charm!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, 458, 2)
				TakeObj(Player, 434, 1)
				GiveObj(Player, 120, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 2 Cut Amethysts and 1 Perfect Diamond to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
	End Select
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a workshop to craft.", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
Dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long
''Cook Fish

Ration = HasObj(Player, 39) + HasObj(Player, 41) + HasObj(Player, 99) + HasObj(Player, 155) + HasObj(Player, 138)

If GetPlayerHP(Player) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) & GetPlayerMana(Player) = GetPlayerMaxMana(Player) Then

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
	If A = 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook fish", Grey)
		Exit Function
	End If
	
If Ration < 3 Then
'Big Fish => Apple
	If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 10 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 148, 10)
		GiveObj(Player, 41, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've cooked 10 Big Fish into a Candy Apple!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
'Medium Fish => Ancient Tome
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 10 Then
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 10)
			GiveObj(Player, 99, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You've cooked 10 Medium Fish into an Ancient Tome!", Yellow)
			Exit Function
		Else
'Small Fish => HP Pot
			If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 10 Then
				TakeObj(Player, 153, 10)
				GiveObj(Player, 39, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You've cooked 10 Small Fish into a Health Potion!", Yellow)
				Exit Function
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You need 10 fish to cook a meal", Grey)
			End If
		End If
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not have more than 3 ration items", Grey)
End If

Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be fully restored to cook fish", Grey)
End If

End Function

Function main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, b as long
b = getplayeragility(player) + getplayerendurance(player) + 5
a = random(b)

if a <= 15 then
playermessage(player,"You attempt to jump the crevice but miss! You fall to your doom. Or a scorpion pit! Be careful.",white)
setplayerhp(player,1)
setplayerenergy(player,1)
playerwarp(player,232, 6, 10)
main = stop
exit function
end if

if a >= 16 then
playermessage(player,"You attempt to jump the crevice and make it across! Good job.",white)
playerwarp(player,231, 10, 7)
main = stop
exit function
end if


end function

Sub Main(Player as Long)

PlayerMessage(Player, "=Player Info=", Yellow)

Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) & HasObj(Player, 69) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Small Fish to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long, Message as String) as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 0 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Sure, how can I help?''", Grey)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Thank you so much Friend. I have an old pelt that my grandfather skinned as a boy. It is falling to pieces. Please take it to the Elvish Tanner in Alephvale, to the North of Greystone Peaks. He will restore it's beauty.''", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I can manage that.", DarkGrey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Hmm, maybe I'm busier than I thought. I'll pass.", DarkGrey)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''My time is worth more than pity errands.''", Grey)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Oh I see how it is.", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 1 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I can manage that.''", Grey)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 2)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Here is the pelt. Please take care of it.''", Yellow)
		GiveObj(Player, 291, 1)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Hmm, maybe I'm busier than I thought. I'll pass.''", Grey)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Ok, maybe later.", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 2 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Just fine, I'll be done in no time.''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Good to hear Friend.", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Where was it I was to take the pelt to again?''", Grey)

		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "3") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I've...lost your pelt... my bad.''", Grey)

		GiveObj(Player, 291, 1)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 2)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 3 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I've taken the pelt to Velatre and he's made a jacket for you!''", Grey)
		If HasObj(Player, 284) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Thank you Friend! But would you mind...Please take it to the Wizard in Dragonia for me, he has promised to waterproof it for me.''", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Fine...''", Grey)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 4)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''I do not see it... Go fetch it quick!''", Yellow)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function

		GiveObj(Player, 291, 1)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 2)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 4 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I'm still tracking down the Wizard.''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Maybe there's Trapper's blood in you after all!''", Yellow)

	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long

If GetMapPlayerCount(591) > 0 Then
	Select Case Random(4)+1
		Case 1
			X = 3
			Y = 3
		Case 2
			X = 10
			Y = 4
		Case 3
			X = 3
			Y = 8
		Case 4
			X = 8
			Y = 8
	End Select

	CreateTileEffect(591, X, Y, 1, 40, 8, 0, 0)
	CreateTileEffect(591, X, Y, 45, 40, 8, 1, 0)
	Timer(Player, 2, "SancFires")
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 242) = 2 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Velatre says, ''Joe is a murderous human, and none too smart. He kills without restraint. However his grandfather was a fine trapper. I shall make a jacket from the pelt scraps in his honour.''", Yellow)
	If HasObj(Player, 291) Then
		TakeObj(Player, 291, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Velatre says, ''Take this to Joe.''", Yellow)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 242, 3)
		GiveObj(Player, 284, 1)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Velatre says, ''Bring me the pelt and I shall begin right away.''", Yellow)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long, Message as String) as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 0 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Ehh, ok...sir!''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Good lad, now away you go.''", Yellow)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 1)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Manners don't cost a thing.''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Suit yerself.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 1 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I'm on it.''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Good lad, now away you go.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Where was I meant to get the bucket from again?''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Northcoast town, East of Dragonia. The Crafter there has made me one before.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

End Function

Name: mapsay4
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long, Message as String) as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 2 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I am in need of some Metal Bands for a bucket. Madargan said you'd still have the diamentions from last time.''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Very well, bring me 3 Smelted Metals and I shall get to work.''", Yellow)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 3)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''How do I make Smelted Metal?''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Take Ore that you have mined to my Forge in the back of this room.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 3 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I'll have the Smelted Metal ready soon.''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Very well, remember that I require 3 Metals.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''How do I make Smelted Metal?''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Take Ore that you have mined to my Forge in the back of this room.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 4 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Where does he live again?''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Madargan Gar lives in Northcoast, North of here and to the East of Dragonia.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I lost those Metal Bands...''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Garad says, ''Not a very good adventurer are you... Bring me more Metals''", Yellow)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 3)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

Function Main(Player as Long, Message as String) as Long

		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''I'd be delighted.''", Grey)

		Main = Stop
		Exit Function

	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Where can I find Babylon?''", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Sanctuary Wench says, ''Babylon is to the East, North of the Tower, across the water.''", Yellow)
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

Function Main(Player as Long, Message as String) as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 243) = 1 Then
	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Where can I get a Shaman's Amulet?''", Grey)

		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where can I find the Troll Shaman?", DarkGrey)

	If strcmp(Message, "1") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Where can I find the Broadsword?''", Grey)

		Main = Stop

	End If
	If strcmp(Message, "2") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You say, ''Where can I find the Troll Shaman?''", Grey)

		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
End If

End Function

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	Dim ChangeCost AS LONG
	Dim A AS LONG
	ChangeCost = 50000
	If StrCmp(Message, "knight") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Knight!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "cleric") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 4)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Cleric!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "mage") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 2)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Mage!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "rogue") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 3)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Rogue!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
   Main = Continue
END FUNCTION

Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long

RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
RunScript1("Restore", Killed)
SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 0)
SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
RunScript1("Sprite", Killed)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count1 = Count1 + 1
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Count2 = Count2 + 1
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Count1 = 0 Then
	GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " and won Team Carnage!")), BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then
				RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
				RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
				GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
				RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
Else
	If Count2 = 0 Then
		GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " and won Team Carnage!")), BrightGreen)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 2 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then
					RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
					RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
					GiveObj(Loop, 483, 1)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
					RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Killer, 11) = 1 Then
			GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " in Team Carnage!")), BrightRed)
		Else
			GlobalMessage(strcat(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killer), " has slain "), strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " in Team Carnage!")), BrightBlue)
		End If
	End If
End If

End Function

FUNCTION Main(Player as LONG, Command as String, Parm1 as String, Parm2 as String, Parm3 as String) AS LONG
Dim A As Long, B As Long, C As Long, D As Long, E As Long, Target As Long

Main = Stop
Target = FindPlayer(Parm1)

	If strcmp(Command, "Tackle") Then
		RunScript1("FootballTackle", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Command, "search") Then
		For A = 1 to 2000
			If InStr(GetMapName(A), Parm1) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, StrCat(Str(A), GetMapName(A)), WHITE)
			End If
		Next A
		Exit Function
	End If

'Secondary Skills
	If strcmp(Command, "smith") Then
		Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
			Case 4
				RunScript2("SmithCren", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 594
				RunScript2("SmithSanc", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 1881
				RunScript2("SmithDrag", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a blacksmith to smith.", Grey)
		End Select
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "cook") Then
		Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
			Case 551
				RunScript2("CookCrags", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 598
				RunScript2("CookSanc", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 950
				RunScript2("CookDrag", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 1882
				RunScript2("CookBab", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a kitchen to cook.", Grey)
		End Select
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "craft") Then
		Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
			Case 300
				RunScript2("CraftNC", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case 593
				Select Case val(Parm1)
					Case 0
						RunScript1("CraftSanc", Player)
					Case 1
						RunScript2("CraftSanc2", Player, val(Parm2))
					Case 2
						RunScript2("CraftSanc4", Player, val(Parm2))
					Case 3
						RunScript2("CraftSanc5", Player, val(Parm2))
					Case Else
						PlayerMessage(Player, "This is not a valid selection.", Grey)
				End Select
			Case 594
				RunScript2("CraftSanc3", Player, val(Parm1))
			Case Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a workshop to craft.", Grey)
			End Select
		Exit Function
	End If

	If strcmp(Command, "scoreboard") Then
		Select Case val(Parm1)
			Case 1
				RunScript1("Scoreboard1", Player)
			Case 2
				RunScript1("Scoreboard2", Player)
			Case 3
				RunScript1("Scoreboard3", Player)
			Case Else
				RunScript1("Scoreboard", Player)
		End Select
		Exit Function
	End If

'Staking Arena
	If StrCmp(Command, "duel") Then
		Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
			Case 1414
				RunScript2("duel", Player, Target)
			Case 1949	
				RunScript2("stake", Player, Target)
			Case Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot duel here.", Grey)
		End Select
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "duelend") Then
		RunScript1("stakeend", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "duelhelp") Then
		RunScript2("duelhelp", Player, val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If

'Trade Room
	If strcmp(Command, "Barter") Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 554 Then
			RunScript2("TradeWarp1", Player, Target)
		Else
			RunScript2("TradeWarp", Player, Target)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If

'Team Arena
	If strcmp(Command, "TeamArena") Then
		RunScript1("TeamArena", Player)
		Exit Function
	End If

'Carnage Host
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 78) = 1 | GetPlayerAccess(Player) Then
	If strcmp(Command, "CarnHost") Then
		RunScript0("CarnHost")
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "Team") Then
		RunScript3("TeamCarn", Player, Val(Parm1), Val(Parm2))
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "FFA") Then
		RunScript3("FFAScript", Player, Val(Parm1), Val(Parm2))
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "Battle") Then
		If Val(Parm2) = 0 Then
			RunScript2("battle", Player, val(Parm1))
		Else
			Timer(Player, Val(Parm2), "Battle")
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Battle Royale runs in ", strcat(Parm2, " seconds.")), White)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "CTF") Then
		RunScript2("CTF", Player, val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "TTD") Then
		If Val(Parm1) = 0 Then
			RunScript0("TTD")
		Else
			Timer(Player, Val(Parm1), "TTD")
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("TTD runs in ", strcat(Parm1, " seconds.")), White)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "Football") Then
		If Val(Parm2) = 0 Then
			RunScript2("Football2", Player, val(Parm1))
		Else
			Timer(Player, Val(Parm2), "Football2")
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Football runs in ", strcat(Parm2, " seconds.")), White)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "Dodgeball") Then
		If Val(Parm1) = 0 Then
			RunScript1("Dodgeball", Player)
		Else
			Timer(Player, Val(Parm1), "Dodgeball")
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Dodgeball runs in ", strcat(Parm1, " seconds.")), White)
		End If
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "TournamentHost") Then
		RunScript2("TournamentHost", Player, val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "Round1") Then
		RunScript0("TournamentRound1")
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "LotteryHost") Then
		RunScript2("LotteryHost", Player, val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "LotteryStart") Then
		RunScript0("LotteryStart")
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "LotteryList") Then
		RunScript0("LotteryList")
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "CarnPop") Then
		RunScript0("CarnPop")
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "TTDTeams") Then
		RunScript0("TTDTeams")
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "Teams") Then
		RunScript2("Teams", Player, Val(Parm1))
		Exit Function
	End If
	If strcmp(Command, "Minigames") Then
		RunScript1("Minigame", Player)
		Exit Function
	If strcmp(Command, "spawnmonster") Then
		SpawnMonster(GetPlayerMap(Player),val(Parm1),GetPlayerX(Player),GetPlayerY(Player))
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	End If
End If

If GetPlayerAccess(Player) > 0 Then
	RunScript0("Command3")
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Invalid command!", Yellow)
End If

End Function

Name: magicarmour

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Mana as Long

Mana = 45

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) >= Mana Then
		If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, 5) = 120 Then
			SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
			RunScript1("cooldown", Player)
				SetEquippedItemSuffix(Player, 5, 250)
				Timer(Player, 2, "MagicArmour2")
			CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Hammer Time!", BrightGreen)
			CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 24, 40, 8, 1, 0)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require Freya's Charm to cast this.", Grey)
		End If
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting again.", Grey)
	End If
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that often.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 17, 0)
PlayerWarp(Player, 554, 6, 10)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 17) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
Next Loop
If Count = 0 Then
	SetFlag(152, 0)
	MapMessage(554, "A new trade can now begin.", Yellow)
End If

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long, Message as String) as Long

If strcmp(Message, "help") Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "=Secure Trading Rooms Help=", White)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Stand on the correct tiles and type /barter <player>.", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Drop the items that are to be traded and stand on your blue tile. DO NOT drop items on the blue tiles.", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "While on the blue tiles type /barter <player> again.", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Only the first person onto their tile may start the trade.", Yellow)
End If

Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)
dim Mana as Long

Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMana(Player), 3)

If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player)) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub

	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	SetPlayerMana(Target, GetPlayerMana(Target) + Mana)
	If GetPlayerMana(Target) > GetPlayerMaxMana(Target) Then SetPlayerMana(Target, GetPlayerMaxMana(Target))
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Victima!", BrightGreen)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Target, str(Mana), BrightBlue)
	CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Target), Target, 2, 40, 8, 0, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 96, 0)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
Dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long
'Mage Spell - Clandestine

Mana = 35
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Noctem!", BrightGreen)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerClass(Loop) = 3 Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 29, 1)
					PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has improved your stealth."), White)
					CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Loop, 21, 40, 8, 0, 0)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Name: PUSH
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long, Z as Long
dim Loop as Long, Map as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 76) = 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must have full Health to use Push.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 6, "PushTimer")
MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has used Push!"), BRIGHTRED)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
		Z = Y - 1
		If Y < 1 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Z) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Z)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
		Z = Y + 1
		If Y > 10 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Z) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Z)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		Z = X - 1
		If X < 1 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, Z, Y) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, Z, Y)
			End If
		Next Loop
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		Z = X + 1
		If X > 10 Then Exit Sub
		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If GetTileAtt(Map, Z, Y) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, Z, Y)
			End If
		Next Loop
End Select

End Sub

function main(player as long) as long
dim a as long, b as long, c as long, d as long

globalmessage("A Random Team Carnage has started!",brightblue)
globalmessage("Map: Team Swamp Carnage",white)

b = 0
c = 0
d = 0
setflag(60,0)
setflag(61,0)


'//========Teams=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers

If getplayermap(a)= 68 then
if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
b = random(1)

if b = 0 then

if c >= d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 45)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 47)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
end if

else

if c < d then
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 31)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 47)
c = c + 1
setflag(60,getflag(60) + 1)
else
SetPlayerFlag(A, 5, GetPlayerGuild(A))
SetPlayerGuild(A, 30)
SetPlayerSprite(A, 45)
d = d + 1
setflag(61,getflag(61) + 1)
end if

end if
else
end if
else
end if

next a

'//========Warp=======//

for a = 1 to getmaxusers
if getplayermap(A) = 68 then
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 30 Then PlayerWarp(A, 161, 2, 6)
 If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 31 Then PlayerWarp(A, 151, 9, 5)
 If GetPlayerAccess(A) > 5 Then PlayerWarp(A, 161, 1, 1)
end if
next a

end function

SUB Main(Player as LONG, Parm1 as LONG) 
Dim sevendigit as LONG, a as LONG, roundcheck as LONG

sevendigit = Parm1 
 
'Finds the middle 3 numbers of a seven-digit number (xxOOOxx) 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If sevendigit >= 1000000 Then 
      sevendigit = sevendigit - 1000000 
   End If 
Next a 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If sevendigit >= 100000 Then 
      sevendigit = sevendigit - 100000 
   End If 
Next a 

roundcheck = sevendigit 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If roundcheck >= 10000 Then 
      roundcheck = roundcheck - 10000 
   End If 
Next a 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If roundcheck >= 1000 Then 
      roundcheck = roundcheck - 1000 
   End If 
Next a 
For a = 1 to 10 
   If roundcheck >= 100 Then 
      roundcheck = roundcheck - 100 
   End If 
Next a 
sevendigit = sevendigit - roundcheck 
sevendigit = Divide(sevendigit,100) 
PlayerMessage(Player,str(sevendigit),BrightGreen) 
End SUB

SUB Main(Player as LONG,Parm1 as LONG,Parm2 as LONG,Parm3 as LONG)
'\marketsell -inventory slot- -amount- -price-
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim slot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,objectcode as LONG,prefixsuffixcode as LONG

objectnum = GetPlayerInvObject(Player,Parm1)

If Parm1 = 0 | Parm1 > 21 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player,"Your inventory slots are 1-20. Try and pick one that actually exists.",BrightRed)
	Exit Sub
End If
If objectnum = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player,"There's nothing in that inventory slot, skippy.",BrightRed)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
	If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
		If Parm2 = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"Yeah, no one is going to buy 0 of something. Put in a value.",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm2 >= 100000 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"You can stack up to 99,999 at a time. That's more than enough. Who has 100,000 of anything besides Gold?",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If GetPlayerInvValue(Player,Parm1) < Parm2 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"I'm sure you wish you had that many to sell, but you don't.",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm3 = 0 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"You don't REALLY wanna give that out for free, do you? At least put 1.",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm3 > 10000000 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"10,000,000 is already a ripoff maximum value, why don't you just use that?",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		For slot = 1 to 15
			If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),""), "") Then
				objectcode = 100000000 + (Parm2 * 1000) + objectnum
				WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),str(objectcode))

				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat(Str(Parm2),StrCat(" ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("s put up for the price of ",StrCat(Str(Parm3)," Gold each."))))),Yellow)
				End If
				slot = 16
			End If
			If slot = 15 Then PlayerMessage(Player,"You don't even have room for this! Sell or take out your items.",BrightRed)
		Next slot
	Else
		If Parm3 = 0 Then

			Exit Sub
		End If
		If Parm3 > 10000000 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player,"10,000,000 is already a ripoff maximum value already, why don't you just use that?",BrightRed)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		For slot = 1 to 15
			If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),""), "") Then
				objectcode = 100001000 + objectnum
				WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),str(objectcode))
				WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot + 100),str(Parm3))
				TakeObj(Player,objectnum,1)
				PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("1 ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat(" put up for the price of ",StrCat(Str(Parm3)," Gold.")))),Yellow)

			End If
			If slot = 15 Then PlayerMessage(Player,"You don't even have room for this! Sell or take out your items.",BrightRed)

	End If
Else

Source:
SUB Main(Player as LONG)
'\marketcheck
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim slot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,specialvalue as LONG,a as LONG,price as LONG
PlayerMessage(Player,ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL","Prophet of Fire",""),Yellow)

For slot = 1 to 15
   If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),""), "") Then
	'Empty Slot
   Else
      objectnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),"")) - 100000000
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 100000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 100000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000
         End If
      Next a
      price = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot + 100),""))
      If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 Then
         PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))),Yellow)
      Else
         specialvalue = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(slot),"")) - 100000000
         specialvalue = specialvalue - objectnum
         specialvalue = Divide(specialvalue,1000)
         If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat(" ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("s ",StrCat("   Price: ",str(price))))))))),Yellow)
         Else
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Durability: ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))))),Yellow)
         End If
      End If
   End If
Next slot
PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Money in Market: ",ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")),Yellow)
End SUB

   PlayerMessage(Player,"There's nothing in that slot!",BrightRed)

   For openinvslot = 1 to 20
      objectnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),str(Parm1),"")) - 100000000

            objectnum = objectnum - 10000000

Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1352 Then
	BanPlayer(Player, 5, "")
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 101) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have been banned from Solo the Champ.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub

If GetFlag(89) < 11 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Solo the Champ is closed.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot join Solo the Champ yet.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be on a friendly map to warp to Solo the Champ.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not warp to Solo the Champ from vaults.", Yellow)
	Exit Sub
End If

RunScript1("GameWarpSet", Player)
	If GetMapPlayerCount(1828) <= GetMapPlayerCount(1829) Then
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1828, 1, 1)
	Else
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1829, 1, 1)
	End If	
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 5, "PushTimer")

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
'Cleric Heal

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 2)
Health = GetPlayerDamage(Player) - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) + 2), 5)
Health = Health + Divide(GetPlayerConcentration(Player), 5)

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Ave Maria!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
'		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
			If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
					If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
						If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
							If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
								If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								Else
									'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
								End If
							Else
								RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
							End If
						Else
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
								If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
									If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									Else
										'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
									End If
								Else
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
'		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Name: smithhigh
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long) AS LONG
dim Metal as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to smith.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

Metal = 448

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 174 Then
	Select Case Parm1
		Case 0
			PlayerMessage(Player, "=Smithing Menu=", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Soulbinders - 10 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Crown of Zeugg - 15 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Ztiwhborflail - 25 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Hero's Guard - 30 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "5. Repair Hero's Guard - 3 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, " - This will repair the first Hero's Guard to appear in your inventory, and will not repair any if equipped.", Grey)
'			PlayerMessage(Player, "smith # to smith an item", Grey)
		Case 1
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 10 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed some Soulbinders!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 10)
				GiveObj(Player, 117, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 2
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 15 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Crown of Zeugg!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 15)
				GiveObj(Player, 197, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 3
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 25 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Ztiwhborflail!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 25)
				GiveObj(Player, 250, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)

			End If
		Case 4
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 30 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Hero's Guard!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 30)
				GiveObj(Player, 248, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 5
			If HasObj(Player, 248) Then
				If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 3 Then
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You have repaired a Hero's Guard!", Yellow)
					TakeObj(Player, Metal, 3)
					RunScript1("repairheros", Player)
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Devilkin Metal to repair that.", Grey)
				End If
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have a Hero's Guard to repair.", Grey)
			End If
	End Select
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a blacksmiths to smith.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Chance as Long, X as Long, Y as Long

Chance = Random(5)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
End Select

Select Case Chance
	Case 1
		SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 448, 3, X, Y)
End Select

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)

'Coarse Ore => 
	If HasObj(Player, 216) >= 10 Then
			TakeObj(Player, 216, 10)
			GiveObj(Player, 221, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted 10 Coarse Ore into some Smelted Metal!", Yellow)
			Exit Sub
	Else
'Flawed Ore => 
		If HasObj(Player, 217) >= 5 Then
				TakeObj(Player, 217, 5)
				GiveObj(Player, 221, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted 5 Flawed Ore into some Smelted Metal!", Yellow)
				Exit Sub
		Else
'Pure Ore => 
			If HasObj(Player, 218) Then
				TakeObj(Player, 218, 1)
				GiveObj(Player, 221, 1)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted a Pure Ore into some Smelted Metal!", Yellow)
				Exit Sub
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 1 Pure Ore, 5 Flawed Ores or 10 Coarse Ore to smelt into Metal.", White)
			End If
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Name: smith
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Metal as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to smith.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Metal = 221

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 4 Then
	Select Case Parm1
		Case 0
			PlayerMessage(Player, "=Smithing Menu=", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Assassin Dagger - 20 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Protection Ring - 25 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Dragon Tooth - 50 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Sun Blade - 70 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "5. Excalibur - 100 Metals", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /smith # to smith an item.", White)
		Case 1
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 20 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed an Assassin Dagger!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 20)
				GiveObj(Player, 95, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 2
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 25 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Protection Ring!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 25)
				GiveObj(Player, 214, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 3
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 50 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Dragon Tooth!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 50)
				GiveObj(Player, 121, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)

			End If
		Case 4
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 70 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Sun Blade!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 70)
				GiveObj(Player, 159, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 5
			If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 100 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Excalibur!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Metal, 100)
				GiveObj(Player, 135, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
	End Select
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a blacksmiths to smith.", Grey)

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG

'Pure Ore => Pure Metal
	If HasObj(Player, 218) >= 5 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 218, 5)
		GiveObj(Player, 448, 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted 5 Pure Ore into some Devilkin Metal!", Yellow)
		Exit Function
	Else
		If HasObj(Player, 221) >= 5 Then
			TakeObj(Player, 221, 5)
			GiveObj(Player, 448, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You've smelted 5 Smelted Metals into some Devilkin Metal!", Yellow)
			Exit Function
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 5 Pure Ore to smelt into Devilkin Metal", Grey)
		End If
	End If

End Function

Function Main(player as long) as long
dim a as long

For A = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerGuild(A) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(A, 10) = 1 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 0)
			PlayerWarp(A, 677, 5, 5)
			BootPlayer(A, "Left Guild in CTF")
		End If
	End If
Next A

'Spectator
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 30 & GetPlayerGuild(Player) <> 31 Then
	Exit Function
End If

'Blue Team
If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 31 Then Exit Function

'Red Team
If getplayerguild(player) = 30 then
If hasobj(player,509) = 1 then	'Has Blue Flag

For A = 0 to getmaxusers
	If HasObj(A, 508) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must recover your flag first!", 15)
		exit function
	end if
Next A

'Red Score
setflag(62,getflag(62)+1)
globalmessage( strcat(getplayername(player), " has scored for the Red Team!"),white)
globalmessage(strcat("<Score> Red Team: ", strcat(str(getflag(62)),strcat(" Blue Team: ",strcat(str(getflag(63)), " <Score>")))),yellow)
takeobj(player,509,1)
ResetMap(124)
ResetMap(149)
ResetMap(150)
for a = 0 to getmaxusers
	If GetPlayerMap(A) = 124 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 149 | GetPlayerMap(A) = 150 Then
		takeobj(a,508,1)
		setplayerstatus(a,0)
		SetPlayerHP(a, GetPlayerMaxHP(a))
		SetPlayerEnergy(a, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(a))
		SetPlayerMana(a, GetPlayerMaxMana(a))
		if getplayerguild(a) = 31 then
			playerwarp(a,124,8,6)
			SetPlayerSprite(a, 133)
		End If
		if getplayerguild(a) = 30 then
			playerwarp(a,150,3,6)
			SetPlayerSprite(a, 132)
		End If
	End If
next a

'Red Team Wins
if getflag(62) = 5 then
 globalmessage("The Red Team has won Capture the Flag!",brightGreen)
 setflag(62,0)
 setflag(63,0)
      
      for a = 0 to getmaxusers
      if getplayermap(a) = 124 | getplayermap(a) = 149 | getplayermap(a) = 150 then
      if getplayeraccess(a) = 0 then
		If GetPlayerGuild(a) = 30 Then GiveObj(A, 504, 1)
		SetPlayerStatus(A,0)
		SetPlayerSprite(A,0)
		SetPlayerGuild(A, GetPlayerFlag(A, 5))
		Playerwarp(A, 677,5,5)
      end if
      end if 
      next a
      Exit Function
end if

SpawnObject(150, 508, 1, 1, 6)
SpawnObject(124, 509, 1, 10, 6)


exit function

else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 150, 2, 6)
exit function
end if
end if
End Function
