Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Slot as Long, Cost as Long

Cost = 3000

If HasObj(Player, 6) < Cost Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You require ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to transmute a Tower Ring.")), Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 59 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 59, 1)
		Select Case Random(3)
			Case 0
				GiveObj(Player, 56, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Jewel of Fenrir!", White)
			Case 1
				GiveObj(Player, 53, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Gem of Valhalla!", White)
			Case 2
				GiveObj(Player, 120, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Freya's Charm!", White)
		End Select
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 56 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 56, 1)
		Select Case Random(3)
			Case 0
				GiveObj(Player, 59, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive an Odin's Shard!", White)
			Case 1
				GiveObj(Player, 53, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Gem of Valhalla!", White)
			Case 2
				GiveObj(Player, 120, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Freya's Charm!", White)
		End Select
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 53 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 53, 1)
		Select Case Random(3)
			Case 0
				GiveObj(Player, 59, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive an Odin's Shard!", White)
			Case 1
				GiveObj(Player, 56, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Jewel of Fenrir!", White)
			Case 2
				GiveObj(Player, 120, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Freya's Charm!", White)
		End Select
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 120 Then
		TakeObj(Player, 120, 1)
		Select Case Random(3)
			Case 0
				GiveObj(Player, 59, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive an Odin's Shard!", White)
			Case 1
				GiveObj(Player, 56, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Jewel of Fenrir!", White)
			Case 2
				GiveObj(Player, 53, 1)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive a Gem of Valhalla!", White)
		End Select
		Exit Sub
	End If
Next Slot

End Sub

Name: smithcren
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Metal as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to smith.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
Metal = 221

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Smithing Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Claymore - 35 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Battle Axe - 28 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Morning Star - 24 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Rapier - 17 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "5. War Mace - 14 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "6. Scimitar - 8 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /smith # to smith an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 35 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Claymore!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 35)
			GiveObj(Player, 28, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 28 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Battle Axe!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 28)
			GiveObj(Player, 2, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 24 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Morning Star!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 24)
			GiveObj(Player, 8, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 4
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 17 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Rapier!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 17)
			GiveObj(Player, 22, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 5
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 14 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a War Mace!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 14)
			GiveObj(Player, 3, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 6
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 8 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Scimitar!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 8)
			GiveObj(Player, 17, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)

Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Metal as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to smith.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
Metal = 221

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Smithing Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Calindori Plate - 28 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Full Plate - 21 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Curiass - 14 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Bascinet - 21 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "5. Plate Helm - 14 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "6. War Helmet - 8 Metals", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /smith # to smith an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 28 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Calindori Plate!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 28)
			GiveObj(Player, 275, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 21 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Full Plate!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 21)
			GiveObj(Player, 305, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 14 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Curiass!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 14)
			GiveObj(Player, 304, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 4
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 21 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Bascinet!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 21)
			GiveObj(Player, 334, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 5
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 14 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a Plate Helm!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 14)
			GiveObj(Player, 335, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 6
		If HasObj(Player, Metal) >= 8 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You smithed a War Helmet!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, Metal, 8)
			GiveObj(Player, 333, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Smelted Metal to smith that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long, Lumber as Long

A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to craft.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Lumber = 215
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 300 Then
	Select Case Parm1
		Case 0
			PlayerMessage(Player, "=Crafting List=", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Longbow - 100 Lumber", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Crossbow - 250 Lumber", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Arrows x30 - 10 Lumber", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Bolts x20 - 10 Lumber", Grey)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "5. Gryphn's Claw - 5000 Lumber", Grey)
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) > 0 & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) < 7 Then PlayerMessage(Player, "6. Bucket - 100 Lumber, 2 Metal Bands", Yellow)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /craft # to craft an item.", White)
		Case 1
			If HasObj(Player, Lumber) >= 100 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Longbow!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Lumber, 100)
				GiveObj(Player, 30, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Lumber to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 2
			If HasObj(Player, Lumber) >= 250 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Crossbow!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Lumber, 250)
				GiveObj(Player, 31, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Lumber to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 3
			If HasObj(Player, Lumber) >= 10 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft some Arrows!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Lumber, 10)
				GiveObj(Player, 71, 30)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Lumber to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 4
			If HasObj(Player, Lumber) >= 10 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft some Bolts!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Lumber, 10)
				GiveObj(Player, 233, 20)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Lumber to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 5
			If HasObj(Player, Lumber) >= 5000 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Gryphn's Claw!!", Yellow)
				TakeObj(Player, Lumber, 5000)
				GiveObj(Player, 232, 1)
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Lumber to craft that.", Grey)
			End If
		Case 6
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) > 0 & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) < 7 Then
				If HasObj(Player, Lumber) >= 100 & HasObj(Player, 461) >= 2 Then
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You craft a Bucket!!", Yellow)
					TakeObj(Player, Lumber, 100)
					TakeObj(Player, 461, 2)
					GiveObj(Player, 466, 1)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "Madargan Gar says, ''Here it is, a brand new bucket for Manny. Go take it to him straight away.", Yellow)
					SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 5)
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You dont have enough Lumber to craft that.", Grey)
				End If
			Else
				PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
			End If
		Case Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
	End Select
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a workshop to craft.", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Card as Long, Score as Long
Score = 0

For Card = 231 To 235
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, Card) <> 1 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, Card) < 11 Then
			Score = Score + GetPlayerFlag(Player, Card)
		Else
			Score = Score + 10
		End If
	End If
Next Card
For Card = 231 To 235
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, Card) = 1 Then
		If Score + 11 > 21 Then
			Score = Score + 1
		Else
			Score = Score + 11
		End If
	End If
Next Card

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 230, Score)
If Score > 21 Then RunScript1("BlackJackBust", Player)

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Guilds as Long, Message as String, Count as Long

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Guilds List==", Yellow)
For Guilds = 1 To 29
	If GetGuildMemberCount(Guilds) > 0 Then
		Count = 0
		Message = strcat(GetGuildName(Guilds), " - ")
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = Guilds Then
					Count = Count + 1
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count > 0 Then
			If Guilds = 16 Then PlayerMessage(Player, Message, BrightBlue) Else PlayerMessage(Player, Message, Guilds)
		End If
	End If
Next Guilds

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long, A as Long, B as Long
dim Loop as Long, Map as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 76) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must order this item from the Online Store.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Sub
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must have full Health to use Push.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 6, "PushTimer")
MapMessage(GetPlayerMap(Player), StrCat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has used Push!"), BRIGHTRED)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
		B = Y - 1
		A = X
		If Y < 1 Then Exit Sub
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
		B = Y + 1
		A = X
		If Y > 10 Then Exit Sub
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		A = X - 1
		B = Y
		If X < 1 Then Exit Sub
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		A = X + 1
		B = Y
		If X > 10 Then Exit Sub
End Select

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map & GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
		If GetTileAtt(Map, A, B) = 0 Then PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, A, B)
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

SUB Main(Player as LONG, Command as String, Parm1 as STRING)
'\marketview -player name-
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore
Dim slot as LONG,objectnum as LONG,specialvalue as LONG,a as LONG,price as LONG,discoveredname as STRING

If strcmp(ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL",Parm1,""), "") Then
   PlayerMessage(Player,strcat("No player by the name ",strcat(Parm1," was found! Make sure the spelling is right.")),BrightRed)
   Exit SUB
Else
   discoveredname = ReadIniStr("PlayerNameLookup","PNL",Parm1,"")
End If


For slot = 1 to 15
   If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),""), "") Then
	'Empty Slot
   Else
      objectnum = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),"")) - 100000000
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 100000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 100000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 10000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 10000
         End If
      Next a
      For a = 1 to 10
         If objectnum >= 1000 Then
            objectnum = objectnum - 1000
         End If
      Next a
      price = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot + 100),""))
      If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 0 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 5 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 7 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 9 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 10 Then
         PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))),Yellow)
      Else
         specialvalue = val(ReadIniStr("Market",discoveredname,str(slot),"")) - 100000000
         specialvalue = specialvalue - objectnum
         specialvalue = Divide(specialvalue,1000)
         If GetObjectType(objectnum) = 6 | GetObjectType(objectnum) = 11 Then
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat(" ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("s ",StrCat("   Price: ",str(price))))))))),Yellow)
         Else
            PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Slot ",StrCat(str(slot),StrCat(": ",StrCat(GetObjectName(objectnum),StrCat("   Durability: ",StrCat(str(specialvalue),StrCat("   Price: ",str(price)))))))),Yellow)
         End If
      End If
   End If
Next slot
End SUB

Name: marscash
Source:
SUB Main(Player as LONG)
'\marketcash
'Script by MarsPhoenix with much help by Fankadore

Dim openinvslot as LONG

If strcmp(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit",""),"") Then
   PlayerMessage(Player,"You have no gold in the marketplace.",Yellow)
Else
   For openinvslot = 1 to 20
      If GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = 0 | GetPlayerInvObject(Player,openinvslot) = 6 Then
         GiveObj(Player,6,Val(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")))
         PlayerMessage(Player,StrCat("Retrieved ",StrCat(ReadIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")," Gold!")),Yellow)
         WriteIniStr("Market",GetPlayerUser(Player),"Profit","")
         openinvslot = 21
      Else
         If openinvslot = 20 Then
            PlayerMessage(Player,"Clear out your inventory! You don't have room.",BrightRed)
         End If
      End If
   Next openinvslot
End If
End SUB

Name: raredrop
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Chance as Long, Object as Long)
Dim X as Long, Y as Long

X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Up Then Y = Y - 1
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Down Then Y = Y + 1 
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Left Then X = X - 1
If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Right Then X = X + 1
If X < 0 | X > 11 Then X = GetPlayerX(Player)
If Y < 0 | Y > 11 Then Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y) <> 0 Then
	X = GetPlayerX(Player)
	Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
End If

If Random(Chance) + 1 = 1 Then SpawnObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), Object, 1, X, Y)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Cost as Long
Cost = 10000

If GetPlayerDirection(Player) = Up Then
	If GetPlayerHP(Player) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 75) = 0 Then
			If HasObj(Player, 6) >= Cost Then
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 5)
				TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
				SetFlag(112, GetFlag(112) + Cost) 'Money Collected
				PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You pay ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold and go through the barrier.")), White)
			Else
				PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 7)
				PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You need ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to enter.")), Grey)
			End If
		Else
			PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 5)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Lofgan says, ''Right this way sir!''", White)
		End If
	Else
		PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 7)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You need full Health to enter.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerWarp(Player, 1213, 5, 7)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Lofgan says, ''Hope you found what you were looking for. Come again soon!''", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, A As Long)
	Dim B as Long, C as Long, D as Long, F as Long
	If GetPlayermap(Player) = 305 & getplayerx(Player) = 4 & getplayery(Player) = 1 Then
	If GetPlayermap(A) = 305 & getplayerx(a) = 7 & getplayery(a) = 1 Then
		Dim E As Long
		E = 0
		For B = 0 to 49
			C = GetObjX(305, B)
			D = GetObjY(305, B)
			F = GetObjNum(305, B)
			If F > 0 & C = 4 & D = 1 Then
				E = 1
			End If
			If F > 0 & C = 7 & D = 1 Then
				E = 1
			End If
		Next B
		
		If E = 1 Then
			MapMessage(305, "Do not drop items on the blue tiles.", WHITE)
		Else
			playerwarp(player, 305, 9,2)
			playerwarp(a, 305, 2,2)
		End If
	End If
	End If
End Sub

Name: keypad
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim K1 as Long, K2 as Long, K3 as Long, K4 as Long
dim Direction as Long

K1 = 1
K2 = 2
K3 = 3
K4 = 4

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 110) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerX(Player) < GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) Then Direction = 1 'Left
	If GetPlayerX(Player) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) Then Direction = 2 'Right
	If GetPlayerY(Player) < GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) Then Direction = 3 'Up
	If GetPlayerY(Player) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) Then Direction = 4 'Down

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 111) = 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 111, Direction)
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 112) = 0 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 112, Direction)
		Else
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 113) = 0 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 113, Direction)
			Else
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 114, Direction)
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 111) = K1 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 112) = K2 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 113) = K3 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 114) = K4 Then
				CreateMapFloatText(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22), "Click!", BrightGreen)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The plates click as they unlock!", White)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 110, 0)
					Select Case GetPlayerMap(Player)
						Case 90
							RunScript1("BossKeypad", Player)
					End Select
					Exit Sub
				End If
				End If
				End If
				End If
				'RESET
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 110, 0)
				PlayerMessage(Player, "The plates click as they reset.", Grey)
			End If
		End If
	End If
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetPlayerClass(Player) = 4 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect your Guild only.", White)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be Guilded to use this.", Grey)
		End If
	Else
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be a Cleric to use this.", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Name: buff
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Buff as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 10) * 9
Buff = GetPlayerDamage(Player) - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) + 2), 5)

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 28) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 28, 1)
RunScript1("BuffCooldown", Player)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerClass(Loop) = 4 Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
					If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
						If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
							RunScript2("Buff1", Loop, Buff)
						Else
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
									RunScript2("Buff1", Loop, Buff)
								End If
							Else
								SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
								RunScript2("Buff1", Loop, Buff)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Slot as Long, A as Long

If RunScript1("Ration", Player) = 1 & Parm1 > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(player, "You can not carry more than three ration items.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
A = 0
For Slot = 1 To 20
	If GetPlayerInvObject(Player, Slot) = 0 Then
		A = A + 1
	End If
Next Slot
If A = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have no room in your inventory to cook.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
	Case 0
		PlayerMessage(Player, "=Cooking Menu=", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Fish Stew - 3 Big Fish, Carrot, Marshroom", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Fish Cakes - 3 Medium Fish, Bread Crumbs", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Sushi - 3 Small Fish", Grey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Type /cook # to cook an item.", White)
	Case 1
		If HasObj(Player, 148) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 103) & HasObj(Player, 69) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Stew!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 148, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 103, 1)
			TakeObj(Player, 69, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 330, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Big Fish, 1 Carrot and 1 Marshroom to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 2
		If HasObj(Player, 152) >= 3 & HasObj(Player, 156) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Fish Cakes!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 152, 3)
			TakeObj(Player, 156, 1)
			GiveObj(Player, 329, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Medium Fish and 1 box of Bread Crumbs to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case 3
		If HasObj(Player, 153) >= 3 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You cooked up some Sushi!", Yellow)
			TakeObj(Player, 153, 3)
			GiveObj(Player, 48, 1)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You require 3 Small Fish to cook that.", Grey)
		End If
	Case Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "That is not a valid option.", Grey)
End Select

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 3) * 2
Health = GetPlayerDamage(Player) - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) + 2), 5)

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Ave Maria!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
			If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
					If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
						If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
							RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
						Else
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
								RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)

	PlayerMessage(Player, "A duel is already in progress.", Grey)

	If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Target) Then

If GetPlayerX(Target) = 4 & GetPlayerY(Target) = 1 Then
	GoTo Warp
End If
End If

Exit Sub

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 14, 1)

End Sub

Name: duelhelp
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long, Parm1 as Long)
dim Map as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

If Map <> 1960 & Map <> 1962 & Map <> 1414 & Map <> 1949 & Map <> 554 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "This is not an arena.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Select Case Parm1
Case 0
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Which part of the House of <PK> would you like to know more about?", White)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. FFA Arena", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Duel Arena", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "3. Stake Arena", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "4. Team Arena", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "5. Trading Room", Grey)
Case 1
	PlayerMessage(Player, "==FFA Arena==", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "In this arena anything goes.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Any number of people can enter/exit the arena at any time.", Grey)
Case 2
	PlayerMessage(Player, "==Duel Arena==", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The duel arena allows two people to duel without interuption.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Two players stand on the tiles at the top and one types /duel <name>.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "This warps the players into the arena, where they fight until one is dead.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "When there is a winner they are both warped out and a new duel can begin.", Grey)
Case 3
	PlayerMessage(Player, "==Stake Arena==", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The stake arena allows you to bet items in a duel.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Two players stand on the brown tiles at the side of the arena. One types /duel <name> and they are warped up.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Both players drop items of their choice on the tiles next to the arena.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "When happy with the stake stand on the green tiles. First player on types /duel <name>.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "When a player dies he is warped below, while the winner is warped to the items at the top.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Once the winner has taken the items and warped down from the fire a new duel can begin.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The same anti-scamming system is used here as is in the Trade Room. Look for help on the Trade Room for more info.", Grey)
Case 4
	PlayerMessage(Player, "==Team Arena==", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The team arena allows many people to fight together regardless of what guild they belong to.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "To join a team simply run onto their team tile. To leave run into the team warp.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "To start the fight, two players from each team must be standing on the start tiles at the top.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "When there are enough players to start the fight type /teamarena.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "There must be two players on each team, but there is no maximum number of players.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "When one team is completely dead all players are warped down and a new duel can begin.", Grey)
Case 5
	PlayerMessage(Player, "==Secure Trade Room==", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Here items can be traded between players without any chance of being ripped off.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Two players stand on the start tiles and one type /barter <name>.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "They are then warped up where they drop what they wish to trade on the floor.", Grey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "The first person onto their blue tile starts the trade.", Grey)

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Guilds as Long, Message as String, Count as Long

GlobalMessage("==Guilds List==", Yellow)
For Guilds = 1 To 29
	If GetGuildMemberCount(Guilds) > 0 Then
		Count = 0
		Message = strcat(GetGuildName(Guilds), " - ")
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = Guilds Then
					Count = Count + 1
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count > 0 Then
			If Guilds = 16 Then GlobalMessage(Message, BrightBlue) Else GlobalMessage(Message, Guilds)
		End If
	End If
Next Guilds

End Function

Name: partylist
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Party as Long, Message as String
dim Count as Long, Count2 as Long, Colour as Long

PlayerMessage(Player, "==Party List==", White)
Count2 = 1
For Party = 1 To 30
	Message = strcat(str(Count2), ". ")
	Count = 0
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = Party Then
				Count = Count + 1
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 202) = 1 Then
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), " (Leader), "))
				Else
					Message = strcat(Message, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), ", "))
				End If				
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	If Count > 0 Then
		If Colour = 4 Then Colour = 6 Else Colour = 4
		PlayerMessage(Player, Message, Party)
		Count2 = Count2 + 1
	End If
Next Party

End Sub

	PlayerMessage(Player, "This means a buy/sell of 250/245 means for each item sold you will earn 245 gold, and each item costs 250 gold to buy.", Grey)
End If

Main = Continue

End Function

Name: partyinvite
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long, Target as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 202) = 1 Then
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then Count = Count + 1
			If Count >= 10 Then 
				PlayerMessage(Player, "Your Party is full.", Grey)
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next Loop
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 203) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have already invited ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " to your party.")), Grey)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have invited ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " to your Party.")), White)
			PlayerMessage(Target, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has invited you to their Party. Type /party join."), White)
			SetPlayerFlag(Target, 203, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201))
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not Leader of the Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Buff as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
'Cleric Endurance Buff

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide(GetPlayerMaxMana(Player), 3) * 2
Buff = 7

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If HasObj(Player, 413) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require Holy Water to cast.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 28) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

'If HasObj(Player, 413) Then
'	Buff = 14
'	TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)
'End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Tu Tela!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 28, 1)
RunScript1("BuffCooldown", Player)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerClass(Loop) = 4 Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
						RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
					Else
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
							If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
								RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
							End If
						Else
							SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
							PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
							RunScript2("Buff3", Loop, Buff)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

	Exit Sub

If ObjNum = 0 Then	'No Current Task
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 40 Then Level = 4
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 39 & GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 60 Then Level = 6
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 59 Then Level = 8
		Select Case Random(Level)
			Case 0
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 76)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 127)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 2
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 78)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 3
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 307)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(11) + 10)
			Case 4
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 151)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(21) + 10)
			Case 5
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 354)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, 1)
			Case 6
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 167)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, Random(5) + 1)
			Case 7
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 355)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, 1)
		End Select
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Trapper Joe says, ''Could I bother you for a favour friend? Would you find me ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 47)), strcat(" ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 46)), "s?''")))), White)
Else
	If HasObj(Player, ObjNum) >= ObjVal Then	'Task Complete
		TakeObj(Player, ObjNum, ObjVal)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 46, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 244, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 244) + 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You successfully complete the task!", BrightGreen)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Trapper Joe says, ''Thank you so much friend.''", White)
		If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 76
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 10k Experience!", Green)
				Case 127
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 15000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 15k Experience!", Green)
				Case 78
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 20k Experience!", Green)
				Case 307
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 25000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 25k Experience!", Green)
				Case 151
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 35000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 35k Experience!", Green)
				Case 354
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 50k Experience!", Green)
				Case 167
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 70000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 70k Experience!", Green)
				Case 355
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 100000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 100k Experience!", Green)
			End Select
		Else
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 354
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 50k Gold!", Green)
				Case 167
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 50k Gold!", Green)
				Case 355
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 60000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You receive 60k Gold!", Green)
			End Select
		End If
	Else 'Task Incomplete
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 47, ObjVal - HasObj(Player, ObjNum))
		TakeObj(Player, ObjNum, HasObj(Player, ObjNum))
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Trapper Joe says, ''Thank you friend, but I still require ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 47)), strcat(" ", strcat(GetObjectName(ObjNum), "s.''")))), White)
	End If
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim ObjNum as Long, Level as Long
ObjNum = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Hey Kid, look lively. I need a new bucket for milking my cows. Head up to the Crafter in Northcoast and get me a new one would ye?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Ehh, ok...sir!", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Manners don't cost a thing.", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) > 0 & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) < 5 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Have you got that bucket for us yet Kid?''", Yellow)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "1. I'm on it.", DarkGrey)
	PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Where was I meant to get the bucket from again?", DarkGrey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 5 Then
	If HasObj(Player, 466) Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''You got my bucket! Good lad! Would you mind milking my cows though? They're in desperate need of it.''", Yellow)
		Exit Sub
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Hey Kid, look lively. I need a new bucket for milking my cows. Head up to the Crafter in Northcoast and get me a new one would ye?''", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "1. Ehh, ok...sir!", DarkGrey)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "2. Manners don't cost a thing.", DarkGrey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 240) = 6 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Thank you my lad. If ever you're in need of a good meal you just see the wife alright?", Yellow)
	TakeObj(Player, 464, 1)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 240, 7)
	'COMPLETED ERRAND OMG
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have completed Manny Farmer's Errand!", BrightGreen)
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
		GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have gained 20k experience!", Green)
	Else
		GiveObj(Player, 6, 100000)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have received 100k Gold Coins!", Green)
	End If
	Exit Sub
End If

If ObjNum = 0 Then	'No Current Task
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 40 Then Level = 3
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 39 & GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 60 Then Level = 5
	If GetPlayerLevel(Player) > 59 Then Level = 6
		Select Case Random(Level)
			Case 0
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 48)	'Sushi
			Case 1
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 113)	'Fruit
			Case 2
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 69)	'Marshroom
			Case 3
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 103)	'Carrot
			Case 4
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 198)	'Cookie
			Case 5
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 41)	'Candy Apple
		End Select
	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Manny Farmer says, ''Looking to make yourself useful kid? Go bring me a ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)), ".''")), White)
Else
	If HasObj(Player, ObjNum) Then	'Task Complete
		TakeObj(Player, ObjNum, 1)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 48, 0)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 244, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 244) + 1)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You successfully complete the errand!", BrightGreen)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "Manny Farmer says, ''Cheers for that kid.''", White)
		If GetPlayerLevel(Player) < 80 Then
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 48
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 10k Experience!", Green)
				Case 113
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 20000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 20k Experience!", Green)
				Case 69
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 30000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 30k Experience!", Green)
				Case 103
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 40000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 40k Experience!", Green)
				Case 198
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 50k Experience!", Green)
				Case 41
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 50000)
					GivePlayerExp(Player, 10000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 60k Experience!", Green)
			End Select
		Else
			Select Case ObjNum
				Case 198
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 50000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 50k Gold!", Green)
				Case 41
					GiveObj(Player, 6, 60000)
					PlayerMessage(Player, "You received 60k Gold!", Green)
			End Select
		End If
	Else 'Task Incomplete
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Manny Farmer says, ''You found that ", strcat(GetObjectName(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 48)), " yet kid?''")), White)
	End If
End If

End Sub

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	If StrCmp(Message, "info") Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "The Frost Wizard tells you, ''I can enchant your items for 30,000 gold coins.  There is no telling what the enchantment will do, and it costs 5,000 gold to remove it.  I can enchant all sorts of things!  To enchant an item, simply say 'enchant' followed by 'weapon', 'helm', 'armor' or 'shield'. The item must be equipped.  If you want to remove an enchantment, say purge followed by weapon, armor, shield, or helm.''", Grey)
	End If
	
	Dim EnchantCost As Long
	EnchantCost = 30000
	if strcmp(message,"enchant weapon") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1) = 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, EnchantCost)
			 Dim Prefix As Long
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1

			 Dim PrefixID As Long
			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("The Frost Wizard says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

		if strcmp(message,"enchant shield") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 2) = 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, EnchantCost)
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1
			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 2, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("The Frost Wizard says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
		if strcmp(message,"enchant armor") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 3) = 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, EnchantCost)
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1

			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 3, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("The Frost Wizard says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
		if strcmp(message,"enchant helm") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 4) = 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, EnchantCost)
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1

			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 4, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("The Frost Wizard says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
	Dim PurgeCost as Long
	PurgeCost = 5000
	if strcmp(message,"purge shield") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 2) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 2, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

	if strcmp(message,"purge weapon") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1) > 0 Then
				If GetPlayerequipped(player,1) < 180 | GetPlayerequipped(player,1) > 192 then
					TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
					SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 1, 0)
					PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
				Else
				 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge Arcticite weapons, fool.''", grey)
			  End If
			Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

	if strcmp(message,"purge armor") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 3) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 3, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

	if strcmp(message,"purge helm") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 4) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 4, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "The Frost Wizard says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
   Main = Continue
END FUNCTION

function main(player as long, message as string) as long

if strcmp(message,"Help") then
playermessage(player, "To use the secure trading room, stand on the left blue tile, with the triangle, and type /barter and then type whoever's name you want to trade with, and the person must be standing on the right blue tile.",white) 
playermessage(player, "You will then enter the trading rooms. You only have TWO MINUTES to trade, and then you are kicked out!",grey)
playermessage(player, "Place your items on the ground (for your customer to see) and when you're both ready, stand on the blue tiles. The player on the left needs to type /switch (playername) of the player on the right blue tile.",white)
playermessage(player, "You will then trade places. Quickly pick up your items, and leave the room by using the warp at the top wall.",grey)
playermessage(player, "(If a player has a space in his name, like Sir Bill, then simply put the name in quotations marks, like /barter ''Sir Bill''.)",white)

end if
main = continue

end function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, Mana as Long
'Void Bolt - Mage Spell
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1427 Then Exit Sub
Effect = 18
Mana = 3
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player)
	If GetPlayerStrength(Player) > 0 Then Damage = Damage - Divide((GetPlayerStrength(Player) +2),5)

	Exit Sub
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
CreatePlayerMagicProjectile(Player, GetPlayerDirection(Player), Effect, Damage)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Mana as Long

Mana = 20
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)

If RunScript1("CheckMap", Player) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require Blinding Powder.", Grey)
	Exit Sub

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)

TakeObj(Player, 407, 1)

	CreateTileEffect(Map,X,Y,10,100,8,0,0)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 2000, 5, 5)
	PlayerWarp(Player, Map, X, Y)
	PlayCustomWav(Player, 13)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Min Ex!", BrightGreen)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player As Long)
dim Mana as Long
'Mage - Lesser Invis
Mana = 30

If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 305 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cant cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 25) <> 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already hidden.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 27) <> 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need full Health to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If HasObj(Player, 408) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You require Nightfall Dust.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 27, 1)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 25, 1)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
TakeObj(Player, 408, 1)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Player))
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Player))
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 21, GetPlayerX(Player))
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 22, GetPlayerY(Player))
SetPlayerStatus(Player, 9)
SetPlayerSprite(Player, 255)
	Timer(Player, 1, "Invis1")

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim A as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long, Mana as Long
Dim CurrentMap as Long, CurrentX as Long, CurrentY as Long
'Mage Spell - Drain

CurrentMap = GetPlayerMap(Player)
CurrentX = GetPlayerX(Player)
CurrentY = GetPlayerY(Player)

	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)

	If IsPlaying(A) Then
		If A <> Player Then
			If GetPlayerMap(A) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
				If GetPlayerIsDead(A) = 1 Then
					CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(A) - CurrentX)
					CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(A) - CurrentY)
					If CalcX < 3 & CalcY < 3 Then
						Mana = GetPlayerMana(A)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) + Mana)
						If GetPlayerMana(Player) > GetPlayerMaxMana(Player) Then SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMaxMana(Player))
						CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 51, 40, 8, 0, 0)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next A
	
End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Mon1 as Long, Mon2 as Long, Mon3 as Long, Mon4 as Long, Mon5 as Long, Mon6 as Long
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 4, 0)

If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0) = Player Then Mon1 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1) = Player Then Mon2 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2) = Player Then Mon3 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3) = Player Then Mon4 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4) = Player Then Mon5 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5) = Player Then Mon6 = 1

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24) = GetPlayerMap(Player) & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) = GetPlayerX(Player) & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) = GetPlayerY(Player) Then
	PlayerWarp(Player, 2000, 5, 5)
	PlayerWarp(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22))
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You have been unfrozen.", Grey)
	If Mon1 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0, Player)
	If Mon2 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1, Player)
	If Mon3 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2, Player)
	If Mon4 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3, Player)
	If Mon5 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4, Player)
	If Mon6 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5, Player)
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You aren't frozen, you dirty liar.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long

SetFlag(11, GetFlag(11) + 1)
TakeObj(Player, 509, 1)
GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has captured the Blue Flag!"), BrightRed)
GlobalMessage(strcat("Red ", strcat(str(GetFlag(11)), strcat(" - ", strcat(str(GetFlag(12)), " Blue")))), Yellow)
If GetFlag(11) = GetFlag(10) Then
	RunScript0("CTFRedWin")
	Exit Sub
End If

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 6 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 70, 1, 10)
				SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 132)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
			End If
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 78, 10, 10)
				SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 133)
				SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
			End If
			RunScript1("Restore", Loop)
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

RunScript0("CTFResetFlags")

End Sub

Name: RES

Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)
dim Map as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	If Map = 66 | Map = 67 | Map = 85 | Map = 87 | Map = 88 | Map = 91 | Map = 93 | Map = 98 | Map = 148 | Map = 167 | Map = 231 | Map = 232 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not resurrect here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Target) & GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
		'Players can resurrect their own guild
	Else
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) = 1 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not resurrect those killed by man.", White)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If GetPlayerFlag(Target, 15) = 2 Then
			PlayerMessage(Player, "This soul has exploded.", White)
			Exit Sub
		End If
	End If

If GetPlayerIsDead(Target) = True Then
	If HasObj(Player, 411) Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 90, 0)
		TakeObj(Player, 411, 1)
		SetPlayerIsDead(Target, False)
		If GetPlayerMap(Target) = 1962 Then
			GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has been resurrected by "), GetPlayerName(Player)), " in the arena, what a newb."), BrightGreen)
		Else
			GlobalMessage(StrCat(StrCat(GetPlayerName(Target), " has been resurrected by "), GetPlayerName(Player)), BrightGreen)
		End If
		CreatePlayerEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, Target, 31, 40, 8, 0)
	Else
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 90, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You require a Living Essence to cast this.", Grey)
	End If
End If

End Sub

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	Dim EnchantCost as Long
	EnchantCost = 80000
	if strcmp(message,"enchant ring") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= EnchantCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5) = 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, EnchantCost)
			 Dim Prefix as Long
			 Dim PrefixID as Long
			 Prefix = Random(8) + 1

			 Select Case Prefix
				Case 1
				   PrefixID = 1
				Case 2
				   PrefixID = 11
				Case 3
				   PrefixID = 21
				Case 4
				   PrefixID = 31
				Case 5
				   PrefixID = 41
				Case 6
				   PrefixID = 51
				Case 7
				   PrefixID = 61
				Case 8
				   PrefixID = 71
				Case Else
				   GlobalMessage("Enchanting error!", BRIGHTRED)
			 End Select
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5, PrefixID)
			 PlayerMessage(player, StrCat(StrCat("Taylor Tailor says, ''I have given your item the enchantment ", GetPrefixName(PrefixID)), ".''"),grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''That item has already been enchanted!''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 2,000 gold to enchant.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if
	
	Dim PurgeCost as Long
	PurgeCost = 10000
	if strcmp(message,"purge ring") then
	   If HasObj(Player, 6) >= PurgeCost Then
		  If GetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5) > 0 Then
			 TakeObj(Player, 6, PurgeCost)
			 SetEquippedItemPrefix(Player, 5, 0)
			 PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''I have purged your item of it's magic.''",grey)
		  Else
			 PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''I cannot purge that item, because it has no magic power.''",grey)
		  End If
	   Else
		  PlayerMessage(player, "Taylor Tailor says, ''You don't have enough money!  You need 5,000 gold to purge.''",grey)
	   End If
	end if

   Main = Continue
END FUNCTION

function main(player as long, message as string) as long

if getplayerflag(player,12) = 1 then
if instr(message,"window") then
playermessage(player,"Sleeping Man says, ''Amazing! You are indeed worthy of passing. Go on now, before I change my mind.''",grey)
opendoor(444,6,0)
setplayerflag(player,12,0)
main = stop
exit function
else
playermessage(player,"Sleeping Man says, ''Wrong! You have failed my test. Now get out of my house!''",grey)
playerwarp(player,444,3,4)
setplayerflag(player,12,0)
main = stop
exit function
end if
end if

if getplayerflag(player,12) = 0 then
if instr(message,"yes") then
playermessage(player,"Sleeping Man says, ''I am an ancient invention still used in some parts of the world today that allows people to see through walls. What am I?''",grey)
playermessage(player,"Please type the answer to the riddle.", brightblue)
setplayerflag(player,12,1)
main = stop
exit function
end if

if instr(message,"no") then
playermessage(player,"Sleeping Man says, ''Fine then!''",grey)
playermessage(player,"You are kicked out of the mans house!", white)
playerwarp(player,444,3,4)
setplayerflag(player,12,0)
main = stop
exit function
end if
end if

main = continue
end function

Name: PARTGAME
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long) as Long
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long, A as Long

'Artifacts
	If HasObj(Player, 393) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)
	If HasObj(Player, 389) Then RunScript1("ArtifactSpawn", Player)

'Lottery
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220) > 0 Then
		SetFlag(120, GetFlag(120) - 1)
		SetFlag(121, GetFlag(121) - 3000)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) > GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220) Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) - 1)
			End If
		Next Loop
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 220, 0)
	End If
	
'Party
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
			PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has left your party."), White)
		End If
	Next Loop
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 202) = 1 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 202, 0)
			For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 202, 1)
					Goto Finish
				End If
			Next Loop
	End If
End If
Finish:

'Solo the Champ
If GetFlag(90) = Player Then SetFlag(90, 0)
If GetFlag(95) = Player Then SetFlag(95, 0)
'Jims game
If GetFlag(96) = Player Then SetFlag(96, 0)
If GetFlag(97) = Player Then SetFlag(97, 0)

'Titan Takedown
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 4 Then
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 0)
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 12, 0)
End If
   
'Carn
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 1 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 0)
			For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
				If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
					If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 1 Then
						Count = Count + 1
						A = Loop
					End If
				End If
			Next Loop
		If Count = 1 Then
			GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(A), " has won Carnage!"), BrightGreen)
			PlayerWarp(A, 8, 9, 7)
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 10, 0)
		End If
	End If

'CTF
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 6 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 0)
		If HasObj(Player, 508) Then
			GlobalMessage("The Red Flag has been returned!", BrightRed)
			TakeObj(Player, 508, HasObj(Player, 508))
			SpawnObject(70, 508, 1, 1, 6)
			SetFlag(181, 0)
		End If
		If HasObj(Player, 509) Then
			GlobalMessage("The Blue Flag has been returned!", BrightBlue)
			TakeObj(Player, 509, HasObj(Player, 509))
			SpawnObject(78, 509, 1, 10, 6)
			SetFlag(182, 0)
		End If
	End If

'Stake Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 13) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 13, 0)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 13) > 0 Then
				Count = Count + 1
				A = Loop
			End If
		Next Loop
		If Count = 0 Then
			SetFlag(150, 0)
			MapMessage(1949, "A new duel can now begin.", Yellow)
		Else
			SetPlayerFlag(A, 13, 4)
			PlayerWarp(A, 1949, 4, 2)
			MapMessage(1949, strcat(GetPlayerName(A), "wins by default!"), Yellow)
		End If
	End If

'Duel Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 14) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 14, 0)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 14) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
		Next Loop
		If Count = 0 Then
			SetFlag(151, 0)
			MapMessage(1414, "A new duel can now begin.", Yellow)
		End If
	End If

'Trade Room
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 17) > 0 Then
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 17, 0)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 17) > 0 Then Count = Count + 1
		Next Loop
		If Count = 0 Then
			SetFlag(152, 0)
			MapMessage(554, "A new trade can now begin.", Yellow)
		End If
	End If

'Team Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 13 Then
		If GetFlag(153) = 1 Then
			MapMessage(1443, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " forfeits by logging."), Yellow)
			SetPlayerGuild(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 5))
			RunScript0("TeamArenaWin")
		End If
	End If

'Tournament Arena
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) = 14 Then
		For Loop = 171 To 178
			If GetFlag(Loop) = Player Then SetFlag(Loop, 0)
		Next Loop
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then RunScript1("TournamentForfeit", Player)
	End If

RunScript1("ResetFlags", Player)

Main = Continue
End Function

Name: getobj282
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long) as Long
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Dir as Long, Loop as Long, Ran as Long
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Ran = Random(2) + 1

For Loop = 1 To Ran
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		If X < 0 Then
			If Map = 1423 Then
				Goto Backwards
			Else
				Map = Map - 1
				X = 11
			End If
		End If
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		If X > 11 Then
			If Map = 1425 Then
				Goto Backwards
			Else
				Map = Map + 1
				X = 0
			End If
		End If
End Select

If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 11 Then	'Goal
	ResetMap(GetPlayerMap(Player))
	RunScript1("FootballWarp", Map)
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 Then
		RunScript2("FootballRedGoal", Player, Map)
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 2 Then
		RunScript2("FootballBlueGoal", Player, Map)
	End If
	Exit Function
End If
If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 0 Then
'	DestroyObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0)
'	DestroyObject(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1)
	ResetMap(GetPlayerMap(Player))
	ResetMap(Map)
	SpawnObject(Map, 282, 1, X, Y)
Else
Backwards:
	Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
		Case Up
			Y = Y + 2
		Case Down
			Y = Y - 2
		Case Left
			X = X + 2
		Case Right
			X = X - 2
	End Select
	'DestroyObject(Map, 0)
	'DestroyObject(Map, 1)
	ResetMap(Map)
	SpawnObject(Map, 282, 1, X, Y)
	Exit Function
End If
Next Loop

End Function

Name: footballwarp

Sub Main(Map as Long)
dim Loop as Long

If Map = 1423 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 11 Then
			Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11)
				Case 1
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 4, 5)
				Case 2
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 9, 6)
				Case 3
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 5, 0)
				Case Else
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 6, 11)
			End Select
		End If
	Next Loop
	SpawnObject(1424, 282, 1, 5, 5)
Else
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 11 Then
			Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11)
				Case 1
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 2, 5)
				Case 2
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 7, 6)
				Case 3
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 5, 0)
				Case Else
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 6, 11)
			End Select
		End If
	Next Loop
	SpawnObject(1424, 282, 1, 6, 6)
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)

If GetFlag(100) > GetFlag(101) Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 1 | GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 3 Then
		GiveObj(Player, 483, 1)
	End If
Else
	If GetFlag(100) <> GetFlag(101) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 2 | GetPlayerFlag(Player, 11) = 4 Then
			GiveObj(Player, 483, 1)
		End If
	End If
End If
PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You scored ", strcat(str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 12)), " goals!")), BrightGreen)
RunScript1("GameWarp", Player)

SetPlayerGuild(Player, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 5))
RunScript1("Sprite", Player)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 12, 0)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Size as Long)
dim Loop as Long
If Size = 0 Then Size = 5
SetFlag(102, 0)
SetFlag(103, 0)
SetFlag(104, Size)
SetFlag(99, 6)	'Time
GlobalMessage(strcat(str(Size), "-a-side Football has started!"), BrightGreen)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 | GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 78) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 5, 0)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 10, 11)
				SetPlayerFlag(Player, 11, 0)
			Else
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 11)
				If GetFlag(102) = GetFlag(104) Then
					Select Case Random(2)
						Case 0
							PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 5, 0)
						Case 1
							PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 6, 11)
					End Select
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
				Else
					If GetFlag(102) < GetFlag(103) | GetFlag(102) = 0 Then
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 4, 5)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 1)
						SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
						SetFlag(102, GetFlag(102) + 1)
					Else
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 8, 6)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 7)
						SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
						SetFlag(103, GetFlag(103) + 1)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

SpawnObject(1424, 282, 1, 5, 6)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Size as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long
If Size = 0 Then Size = 5
SetFlag(82, 0)
SetFlag(102, 0)
SetFlag(103, 0)
SetFlag(104, Size)
SetFlag(99, 6)	'Time
GlobalMessage(strcat(str(Size), "-a-side Bloodball has started!"), BrightGreen)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()	'Random Teams
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 | GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 78) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 5, 0)
			Else
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 11)
			Select Case Random(4)
				Case 1 'Red Team
					If GetFlag(102) < GetFlag(104) Then
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 4, 5)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 132)
						SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
						SetFlag(102, GetFlag(102) + 1)
					Else
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 6, 11)
					End If
				Case 2 'Blue Team
					If GetFlag(103) < GetFlag(104) Then
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 8, 6)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 133)
						SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
						SetFlag(103, GetFlag(103) + 1)
					Else
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 6, 11)
					End If
				Case Else 'Sub
					If Count1 <= Count2 Then	'Red Sub
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 5, 0)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 3)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 1)
						Count1 = Count1 + 1
					Else						'Blue Sub
						PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 6, 11)
						SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 4)
						SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 7)
						Count2 = Count2 + 1
					End If
			End Select
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()	'Even Teams
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 3 Then
		If GetFlag(102) < GetFlag(104) Then
			PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 4, 5)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 132)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
			SetFlag(102, GetFlag(102) + 1)
		End If
	End If
	If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 4 Then
		If GetFlag(103) < GetFlag(104) Then
			PlayerWarp(Loop, 1424, 8, 6)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 133)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
			SetFlag(103, GetFlag(103) + 1)
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

SpawnObject(1424, 282, 1, 5, 6)

End Sub

Name: footballtackle
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, X2 as Long, Y2 as Long
dim Loop as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 10) <> 11 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may only use this is Football.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
		Y2 = Y - 1
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
		Y2 = Y + 1
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
		X2 = X - 1
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
		X2 = X + 1
End Select

If GetObjX(Map, 0) = X & GetObjY(Map, 0) = Y Then
	ResetMap(Map)
	SpawnObject(Map, 282, 1, GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player))
End If
If GetObjX(Map, 1) = X & GetObjY(Map, 1) = Y Then
	ResetMap(Map)
	SpawnObject(Map, 282, 1, GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player))
End If

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
	If GetPlayerX(Loop) = X Then
	If GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
		If GetTileAtt(Map, X2, Y2) = 0 Then
			PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X2, Y2)
			MapMessage(Map, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), strcat(" tackles ", GetPlayerName(Loop))), Grey)
		End If
	End If
	End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Function Main(Killer as Long, Killed as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count1 as Long, Count2 as Long

Select Case GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11)
	Case 1
		If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) > 0 Then
			PlayerWarp(Killed, 1525, 5, 5)
			SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 19)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 100)
			SetPlayerHP(Killed, GetPlayerMaxHP(Killed))
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) - 1)
		Else
			PlayerWarp(Killed, 8, 7, 9)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Killed)
			GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Killed), " has been knocked out of Titan Takedown!"), Blue)
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
			RunScript1("sprite", Killed)
		End If
	Case 2
		If GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) > 0 Then
			PlayerWarp(Killed, 1539, 5, 2)
			SetPlayerSprite(Killed, 93)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, 101)
			SetPlayerHP(Killed, GetPlayerMaxHP(Killed))
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 12) - 1)

			PlayerWarp(Killed, 8, 7, 9)

			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Killed, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Killed, GetPlayerFlag(Killed, 5))
			RunScript1("Sprite", Killed)
			CalculateStats(Killed)
		End If
End Select

Count1 = 0
Count2 = 0
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()

		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 1 Then Count1 = Count1 + 1
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11) = 2 Then Count2 = Count2 + 1
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
If Count1 = 0 Then
	GlobalMessage("The Titans have defended their ancient home!", BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
			GiveObj(Loop, 484, 1)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			CalculateStats(Loop)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If
If Count2 = 0 Then
	GlobalMessage("The Invaders have defeated the Titans and conquered their fortress!", BrightGreen)
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 4 Then
			GiveObj(Loop, 483, 1)
			RunScript1("GameWarp", Loop)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
			SetPlayerGuild(Loop, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5))
			RunScript1("Sprite", Loop)
			CalculateStats(Loop)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long, Att as Long, Att2 as Long
'Mage Guild Warp

Mana = 45
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Att = GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y)
Att2 = GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y)

If Map = 1423 | Map = 1424 | Map = 1425 | Map = 1826 | Map = 1949 | Map = 1828 | Map = 1829 | Map = 982 | Att = 5 | Att = 6 | Att = 8 | Att = 11 | Att = 13 | Att2 = 5 | Att2 = 6 | Att2 = 11 | Att2 = 13 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Function
End If

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
		If GetPlayerMana(Player) >= Mana Then
			SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
			RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
			CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Gek Ommen!", BrightGreen)
			CreateCharacterEffect(Map, Player, 12, 40, 8, 0, 0)
			For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
				If Loop <> Player Then
					If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
						If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
							CalcX = Abs(X - GetPlayerX(Loop))
							CalcY = Abs(Y - GetPlayerY(Loop))
							
							If CalcX < 3 & CalcY < 3 Then
								CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), GetPlayerX(Loop), GetPlayerY(Loop), 12, 40, 8, 0, 0)
								PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, X, Y)
								PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat("You have been warped to ", GetPlayerName(Player)), White)
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			Next Loop
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in a guild to cast this spell.", Grey)
End If

End Function

	Case 4
		CarnScript = "SpaceCarn"
	Case 5
		CarnScript = "CavernCarn"
	Case 6

Else
	Timer(1, Time, CarnScript)

End If

End Sub

Source:
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Pot as Long, Loop as Long, Number as Long, Cost as Long

Pot = GetFlag(121)
Cost = GetFlag(124)
Number = 1

If GetFlag(122) = 1 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220) > 0 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Your ticket number is ", str(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 220))), White)
		Exit Function
	End If

	If HasObj(Player, 6) >= Cost Then
	
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If Loop = Player Then
				Else
					If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) > 0 Then
						If StrCmp(GetPlayerIP(Player), GetPlayerIP(Loop)) Then
							PlayerMessage(Player, "You have already entered the lottery on another account", WHITE)
							Exit Function
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
		
		TakeObj(Player, 6, Cost)
LoopStart:
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) = Number Then
					Number = Number + 1
					Goto LoopStart
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop

		SetFlag(120, GetFlag(120) + 1)
		SetFlag(121, Pot + Cost)
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 220, Number)
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("Your ticket number is ", str(Number)), White)
		If HasObj(Player, 481) = 0 Then GiveObj(Player, 481, 1)
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You require ", strcat(str(Cost), " Gold to play the Lottery.")), Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Lottery is not open.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Ration as Long, Slot as Long, A as Long
Ration = HasObj(Player, 445) + HasObj(Player, 446) + HasObj(Player, 447) + HasObj(Player, 449)

	End If
