	PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not carry more than 3 Stat Potions.", Grey)
End If

End Function

WinNum = Random(GetFlag(120)) + 1

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220) = WinNum Then
			GlobalMessage(strcat("And the winning number is...", strcat(str(WinNum), "!")), Yellow)
			GlobalMessage(strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), strcat(" wins the Jackpot of ", strcat(str(GetFlag(121)), "!!"))), BrightGreen)
			GiveObj(Loop, 6, GetFlag(121) + GetFlag(123))
			SetFlag(120, 0)
			SetFlag(121, 0)
			SetFlag(122, 0)
			Goto ResetFlags
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

ResetFlags:
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 220, 0)
	TakeObj(Loop, 481, 1)
Next Loop
End Function

Name: partyleader
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long, Target as Long) AS LONG

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 202) = 1 Then
		If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Target, 201) Then
			SetPlayerFlag(Target, 202, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 202, 0)
			PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You have made ", strcat(GetPlayerName(Target), " Leader of the Party.")), White)
			PlayerMessage(Target, "You are now Leader of the Party.", White)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "That player is not in your Party.", Grey)
		End If
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not Leader of the Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are not in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name: partyjoin
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Count as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) = 0 Then
	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203) > 0 Then
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203) Then Count = Count + 1
			If Count >= 10 Then 
				PlayerMessage(Player, "That Party is full.", Grey)
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next Loop
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 201, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 203))
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 203, 0)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have joined a Party!", Yellow)
		PlayerMessage(Player, "To leave the party type /party leave.", White)
		RunScript1("partylist", Player)
		For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
			If Player <> Loop Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
					PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has joined your Party."), White)
				End If
			End If
		Next Loop
	Else
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You have not been invited to a Party.", Grey)
	End If
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are already in a Party.", Grey)
End If

End Function

Name: partyleave
Source:
Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Loop as Long, Leader as Long

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) > 0 Then
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If Player <> Loop Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
				PlayerMessage(Loop, strcat(GetPlayerName(Player), " has left your Party."), White)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If Player <> Loop Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 201) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 201) Then
				Leader = Loop
				Goto Finish
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

Finish:
RunScript2("partyleader", Player, Leader)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 201, 0)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 202, 0)
PlayerMessage(Player, "You are no longer part of any Party.", Grey)

End Function

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
dim Mon1 as Long, Mon2 as Long, Mon3 as Long, Mon4 as Long, Mon5 as Long, Mon6 as Long, Monster as Long

If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0) = Player Then Mon1 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1) = Player Then Mon2 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2) = Player Then Mon3 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3) = Player Then Mon4 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4) = Player Then Mon5 = 1
If GetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5) = Player Then Mon6 = 1

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) = 0 Then
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("cooldown", Player)
		For Monster = 0 To 5
			AttackMonster(Player, Monster, 0)
		Next Monster

	If Mon1 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 0, Player)
	If Mon2 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 1, Player)
	If Mon3 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 2, Player)
	If Mon4 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 3, Player)
	If Mon5 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 4, Player)
	If Mon6 = 1 Then SetMonsterTarget(GetPlayerMap(Player), 5, Player)
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to cast again.", Grey)
End If

End Function

else

Sub Main(Player AS LONG)
'Thief - Quick Strike
	Dim Dir AS LONG, DestDir AS LONG
	Dim Map AS LONG, StartX AS LONG, StartY AS LONG
	Dim CheckX AS LONG, CheckY AS LONG
	Dim DestX AS LONG, DestY AS LONG
	Dim Damage AS LONG, Mana AS LONG
	
	Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
	StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Dir = GetPlayerDirection(Player)
'	If HasObj(Player, 298) = 0 Then Mana = 50 Else Mana = 1
	Mana = GetPlayerMaxMana(Player)
	Select Case Dir
		Case 0 'Up
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY - 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY - 1
			DestDir = 1
		Case 1 'Down
			CheckX = StartX
			CheckY = StartY + 1
			DestX = CheckX
			DestY = CheckY + 1
			DestDir = 0
		Case 2 'Left
			CheckX = StartX - 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX - 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 3
		Case 3 'Right
			CheckX = StartX + 1
			CheckY = StartY
			DestX = CheckX + 1
			DestY = CheckY
			DestDir = 2
	End Select
	
	'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
	If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Sub
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting again.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 5 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 11 | GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), DestX, DestY) = 17 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim A AS LONG
	For A = 1 to GetMaxUsers
		If IsPlaying(A) & GetPlayerAccess(A) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerMap(A) = Map & GetPlayerX(A) = CheckX & GetPlayerY(A) = CheckY Then
				If GetTileIsVacant(Map, DestX, DestY) = True Then
					If GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, StartX, StartY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, CheckX, CheckY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, DestX, DestY, DestDir) = True Then
						If Dir = GetPlayerDirection(A) Then
							Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 3)
							CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 38, 60, 8, 0, 0)
						Else
							If (Dir = 0 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 1) | (Dir = 1 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 0) | (Dir = 2 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 3) | (Dir = 3 & GetPlayerDirection(A) = 2) Then
								PlayerMessage(Player, "Your opponent is aware of your intent.", Grey)
								Exit Sub
							Else
								Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 5)
								CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 66, 60, 8, 0, 0)
							End If
						End If
						AttackPlayer(Player, A, Damage)
						PlayerWarp(Player, Map, DestX, DestY)
						SetPlayerDirection(Player, DestDir)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
						Exit Sub
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next A
	
	For A = 0 to 5
		If GetMonsterType(Map, A) > 0 & GetMonsterX(Map, A) = CheckX & GetMonsterY(Map, A) = CheckY Then
			If GetTileIsVacant(Map, DestX, DestY) = True Then
				If GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, StartX, StartY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, CheckX, CheckY, Dir) = True & GetTileNoDirectionalWalls(Map, DestX, DestY, DestDir) = True Then
					If (Dir = 0 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 1) | (Dir = 1 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 0) | (Dir = 2 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 3) | (Dir = 3 & GetMonsterDirection(Map, A) = 2) Then
						PlayerMessage(Player, "Your opponent is aware of your intent.", Grey)
						Exit Sub
					Else
						PlayerWarp(Player, Map, DestX, DestY)
						SetPlayerDirection(Player, DestDir)
						Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Divide(GetPlayerDamage(Player), 4)
	'					AttackMonster(Player, A, Damage)
						SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
						Exit Sub
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next A
End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long)
dim Loop as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long, Damage as Long
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 208, 0)

TakeObj(Player, 413, 1)
RunScript3("ExplosionEffect", Map, X, Y)
CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Damnatio!", BrightRed)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
		If Loop <> Player Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 2 & CalcY < 2 Then
				MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)
			End If
		End If
	End If

	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 208, 0)
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long, Limit as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Team as Long

Start:
If Limit > 0 Then
	GlobalMessage("CTF has begun!", BrightGreen)
	SetFlag(10, Limit)
	SetFlag(82, 0)
	SetFlag(11, 0)
	SetFlag(12, 0)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = 68 Then
			If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) > 0 Then
				PlayerWarp(Loop, 74, 5, 0)
			Else
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 5, GetPlayerGuild(Loop))
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 6)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
				If Team = 0 Then
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 100)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 132)
					SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 17)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 1)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 70, 1, 10)
					Team = 1
				Else
					SetPlayerGuild(Loop, 101)
					SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 133)
					SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 3)
					SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 11, 2)
					PlayerWarp(Loop, 78, 10, 10)
					Team = 0
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

Else
	Limit = 3
	Goto Start
End If
RunScript0("CtfResetFlags")

End Sub

Name: sancgame1
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim X as Long, Y as Long, Loop as Long, Winner as Long
Winner = 0

If GetFlag(139) > 0 Then
	Select Case Random(12)
	Case 0
		X = 2
		Y = 5
		SetFlag(140, 1)
	Case 1
		X = 2
		Y = 6
		SetFlag(140, 2)
	Case 2
		X = 3
		Y = 3
		SetFlag(140, 3)
	Case 3
		X = 3
		Y = 8
		SetFlag(140, 4)
	Case 4
		X = 5
		Y = 2
		SetFlag(140, 5)
	Case 5
		X = 5
		Y = 9
		SetFlag(140, 6)
	Case 6
		X = 6
		Y = 2
		SetFlag(140, 7)
	Case 7
		X = 6
		Y = 9
		SetFlag(140, 8)
	Case 8
		X = 8
		Y = 3
		SetFlag(140, 9)
	Case 9
		X = 8
		Y = 8
		SetFlag(140, 10)
	Case 10
		X = 9
		Y = 5
		SetFlag(140, 11)
	Case 11
		X = 9
		Y = 6
		SetFlag(140, 12)
	End Select
		CreateTileEffect(619, X, Y, 1, 40, 8, 0, 0)
		SetFlag(139, GetFlag(139) - 1)
		Timer(Player, 2, "SancGame1")
Else
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 15 Then
			PlayerWarp(Loop, 617, 5, 5)
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12) > Winner Then
				Winner = GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12)
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop
	For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
		If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10) = 15 Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12) = Winner Then
				MapMessage(617, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), strcat(" wins Fire Catcher with ", strcat(str(Winner), "/20 points!"))), BrightGreen)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 225, GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 225) + 1)
			End If
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 10, 0)
			SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 12, 0)
		End If
	Next Loop
End If

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Buff as Long
dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
'Cleric Endurance Buff

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)

				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then

						Else

							RunScript2("testbuff2", Loop, Buff)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)



If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then	
if getplayerguild(player) = getflag(186) & getflag(185) > 0 then 




	dim Cost as Long
	Cost = 3


	Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, HP as Long

	Dim XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long, MonsterLoop as Long
	
	dim xPos as long, yPos as long


	If HasObj(Player, 603) >= Cost Then

	TakeObj(Player, 603, cost)




	playermessage(player, "The magic artillery pushes you back!", yellow)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 2)
	CreateTileEffect(2114, 1, 0, 1, 100, 8, 0, 0)




	'Area of Effect - Mage Spell - Arcane Rain

	Effect = 45

	Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + 5

	xPos = random(5)

	yPos = random(5)+6

	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()


	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then



		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = getplayermap(player) Then



	

			for xCoord = 0 to 2

			for yCoord = 0 to 2

			

				if getplayerx(loop) = xpos +xCoord & getplayery(loop) = ypos + yCoord then

				


						CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), xpos +xCoord, ypos + yCoord, 45, 50, 6, 4, 0)
						MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)

						

				end if

				

			next xCoord

			next yCoord







		End If



	End If



	Next Loop


	For XCoord = 0 to 2

		For YCoord = 0 to 2





			CreateTileEffect(getplayermap(player), xpos+xcoord, ypos+ycoord, Effect, 33, 10, 0, 0)



		Next YCoord



	Next XCoord








	ELSE

	PlayerMessage(Player, strcat("You need ", strcat(str(Cost), " Fort Ammo to continue.")), brightred)
	PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 1)
	end if

else
playermessage(player, "Your guild does not have special access to the Darkcone Fort.", white)
PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 1)
end if 

else
playermessage(player, "You are not in a guild.", white)
PlayerWarp(Player, 2114, 1, 1)
end if



END SUB

Sub Main(Player as Long)
	dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
	dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long
	dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long




    'Check if we are cooling down still
	if getplayerflag(player, 23) = 1 then
		playermessage(player,"This spell is in cooldown.",white)
		exit sub
	end if

	'Set Cooldown Timer
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	Timer(Player, 3, "Cooldown")
    
  
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	X = GetPlayerX(Player)
	Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Mana = 35
	Health = GetPlayerDamage(Player)
	If Health < 1 Then Health = 1

	If Health > 25 Then Health = 25
	

    If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Ave Maria!", BrightGreen)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
	'		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
				If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
					If Player <> Loop Then
						CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
						CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
						If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
							If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
									If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									Else
										'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
									End If
								Else
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
									If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									End If
								Else
									SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
									PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
									If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
										If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
											RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
										Else
											'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
										End If
									Else
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									End If
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
	'		End If
		End If
	Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
	dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
	dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long, Energy as Long
	dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long


If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
playermessage(player, "You must be in a Guild.", grey)
exit sub
end if

if getplayerflag(player, 23) = 1 then
		playermessage(player,"This spell is in cooldown.",white)
		exit sub
	end if

If HasObj(Player, 280) >= 5 Then
	TakeObj(Player, 280, 2) 
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need Ancient Relics to cast this spell!", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
playermessage(player, "Your spells must be set to Guild only.", grey)
exit sub
end if


    'Check if we are cooling down still
	

	'Set Cooldown Timer
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	Timer(Player, 5, "Cooldown")
    
  

  
  
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	X = GetPlayerX(Player)
	Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Mana = 45
	Energy = 15
	Health = GetPlayerHP(Player) - Divide(GetPlayerMaxHP(Player), 2)
	If Health < 1 Then Health = 1
	





	If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetPlayerHP(Player) >= Health Then
	SetPlayerHP(Player, GetPlayerHP(Player) - Health)
	Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You are too close to death.", Grey)
	End If


	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Sevria Lehr!", BrightGreen)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerEnergy(Player) - Energy)

	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
	'		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
				If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
					If Player <> Loop Then
						CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
						CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
						If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
							If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
								
								If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
									If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									Else
										'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
									End If
								Else
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
									If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
										
									End If
								Else
									End If
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
	'		End If

	Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
	Dim Count as Long, Energy as Long, XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long
	'Area of Effect - Sacrafice Energy
	If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1427 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1828 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1829 Then Exit Sub

	If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 213) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "Cooling down.", Grey)
	exit sub
	end if

	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
				XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerX(Player))
				YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerY(Player))
				If XCoord < 2 & YCoord < 2 Then
					If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
							If Player <> Loop Then
								If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
								Count = Count + 1
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	Next Loop

	If Count > 0 Then
		Energy = Divide(GetPlayerEnergy(Player), Count)
		SetPlayerEnergy(Player, 0)
		CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Nike Tima!", BrightGreen)
			
		SetPlayerFlag(Player, 213, 1)
		Timer(Player, 60, "SACTIMER")

		For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
			If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
				If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
					XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerX(Player))
					YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerY(Player))
					If XCoord < 2 & YCoord < 2 Then
						If Player <> Loop Then
							If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
									If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
										'SetPlayerEnergy(Loop, GetPlayerEnergy(Loop) + Energy)
										'If GetPlayerEnergy(Loop) > GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Loop) Then SetPlayerEnergy(Loop, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Loop))
										'CreatePlayerFloatText(Loop, str(Energy), Yellow)
										CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 46, 50, 20, 1, 0)
										RunScript2("energy1", Loop, Energy)
										End If
									End If
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If

		Next Loop
	End If

End Sub

'RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Energy as Long, Mana as Long
'Cleric Spell - Convert


If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 82) = 1 Then
PlayerMessage(Player, "Cooling down.", Grey)
exit sub
end if

Energy = 85
Mana = 125 

If GetPlayerenergy(Player) >= Energy Then
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 82, 1)
	Timer(Player, 300 , "Convertimer")
	SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerEnergy(Player) - Energy)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) + Mana)
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) > GetPlayerMaxMana(Player) Then SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMaxMana(Player))
	CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 30, 40, 8, 0, 0)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Convert!", BrightGreen)
'	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, str(Health), BrightRed)
Else
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You don't have enough energy.", Grey)
End If

End Sub

Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
	dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
	dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Health as Long
	dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long




    'Check if we are cooling down still
	if getplayerflag(player, 23) = 1 then
		playermessage(player,"This spell is in cooldown.",white)
		exit sub
	end if

	'Set Cooldown Timer
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	Timer(Player, 5, "Cooldown")
    
  
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
	X = GetPlayerX(Player)
	Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
	Mana = 60
	Health = GetPlayerDamage(Player)
	If Health < 1 Then Health = 1

	If Health > 41 Then Health = 41



If GetTileAtt(Map, X, Y) = 6 | GetTileAtt2(Map, X, Y) = 6 Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You may not cast that here.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
		PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Ave Maria!", BrightGreen)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	
	

	For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
		If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
	'		If GetPlayerClass(Loop) <> 4 Then
				If Map = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
					If Player <> Loop Then
						CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
						CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
						If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
							If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 16) = 0 Then
								If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
									If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									Else
										'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
									End If
								Else
									RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
								End If
							Else
								If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
									If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									End If
								Else
									SetPlayerFlag(Player, 16, 0)
									PlayerMessage(Player, "Your spells have been set to affect everyone.", White)
									If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) > 0 Then
										If GetMapIsFriendly(Map) = True | GetMapIsPK(Map) = True Then
											RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
										Else
											'Unguildeds cant heal guildeds on a white map
										End If
									Else
										RunScript2("heal1", Loop, Health)
									End If
								End If
							End If
						End If
					End If
				End If
	'		End If
		End If
	Next Loop

End Sub

Name: spell198
Source:
Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Loop as Long, CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
dim Mana as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Mana = Divide((GetPlayerMaxMana(Player) - Divide(GetPlayerWisdom(Player), 2)), 4)

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be guilded to use this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 27) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Eva Nescent!", BrightGreen)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 27, 1)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
		If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
			CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
			CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
			If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Loop))
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Loop))
				SetPlayerSprite(Loop, GetGuildSprite(GetPlayerGuild(Loop)))
				SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
				SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25, 1)
				Timer(Loop, 10, "TurnVisible3")
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) as Long

dim Monster1 as Long, a as Long
Monster1 = 404
dim Chance as Long, Map as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)


Chance = Random(4)


Select Case Chance
	Case 0
main = continue
	Case 1
main = continue
	Case 2
main = continue
	Case 3

IF GetPlayerDirection(Player) = LEFT THEN
  IF GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), (GetPlayerX(Player) + 1), GetPlayerY(Player)) = FALSE THEN
   IF GetTileAtt2(GetPlayerMap(Player), (GetPlayerX(Player) + 1), GetPlayerY(Player)) = FALSE THEN
 PlayerWarp(Player, GetPlayerMap(Player), (GetPlayerX(Player) + 1), GetPlayerY(Player))
   END IF
  END IF
END IF



IF GetPlayerDirection(Player) = RIGHT THEN
  IF GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), (GetPlayerX(Player) - 1), GetPlayerY(Player)) = FALSE THEN
   IF GetTileAtt2(GetPlayerMap(Player), (GetPlayerX(Player) - 1), GetPlayerY(Player)) = FALSE THEN
 PlayerWarp(Player, GetPlayerMap(Player), (GetPlayerX(Player) - 1), GetPlayerY(Player))
   END IF
  END IF
END IF



IF GetPlayerDirection(Player) = UP THEN
  IF GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), (GetPlayerY(Player) + 1)) = FALSE THEN
   IF GetTileAtt2(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), (GetPlayerY(Player) + 1)) = FALSE THEN
 PlayerWarp(Player, GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), (GetPlayerY(Player) + 1))
   END IF
  END IF
END IF



IF GetPlayerDirection(Player) = DOWN THEN
  IF GetTileAtt(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), (GetPlayerY(Player) - 1)) = FALSE THEN
   IF GetTileAtt2(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), (GetPlayerY(Player) - 1)) = FALSE THEN
 PlayerWarp(Player, GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), (GetPlayerY(Player) - 1))
   END IF
  END IF
END IF


Main=Continue

Name: mapsay2118
Source:
FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	Dim ChangeCost AS LONG
	Dim A AS LONG
	ChangeCost = 35000
	If StrCmp(Message, "knight") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Knight!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "cleric") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 4)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Cleric!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "mage") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 2)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Mage!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "rogue") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 3)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a Rogue!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough gold!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Mana as Long, Loop as Long, X as Long, Y as Long, Gate as Long
'Thief Hide Others
Mana = 30
If RunScript1("CheckMap", Player) = 1 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You cannot cast that here.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) <> 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to use this ability.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerHP(Player) <> GetPlayerMaxHP(Player) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need full Health to use this ability.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate to use this ability.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)

X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		Y = Y - 1
	Case Down
		Y = Y + 1
	Case Left
		X = X - 1
	Case Right
		X = X + 1
End Select

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If GetPlayerMap(Player) = GetPlayerMap(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
			If GetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25) = 0 Then
				If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 27) = 0 Then
					If GetPlayerGuild(Player) > 0 Then
						If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = GetPlayerGuild(Loop) Then
							If Player <> Loop Then
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 25, 1)
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 19, GetPlayerSprite(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 20, GetPlayerStatus(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 21, GetPlayerX(Loop))
								SetPlayerFlag(Loop, 22, GetPlayerY(Loop))
								SetPlayerStatus(Loop, 9)
								SetPlayerSprite(Loop, 255)
								Timer(Loop, 20, "TurnVisible")
								Timer(Loop, 1, "Invis1")
								Gate = 1
							End If
						else
							PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in the same guild as your target.", Grey)
						end if
					else
						PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be in the same guild as your target.", Grey)
					end if
				Else
					PlayerMessage(Player, "Target cannot hide yet.", Grey)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop
If Gate = 1 Then 'Worked
	CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), Player, 61, 40, 8, 0, 0)
	CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y, 57, 40, 8, 0, 0)
Else
	CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), X, Y, 52, 40, 8, 0, 0)
End If

End Sub

Function Main(Player as Long) AS LONG
'Store Command - Push
Dim Map as Long, StartX as Long, StartY as Long
Dim CheckX as Long, CheckY as Long, DestX as Long, DestY as Long
Dim Loop as Long

Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
StartX = GetPlayerX(Player)
StartY = GetPlayerY(Player)

'if getplayerhp(player) <> getplayermaxhp(player) then
	'playermessage(player, "Push requires full hp to use.",white)
	'exit function
'end if

'Push timer - currently disabled
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 109) > 0 Then Exit Function

If GetPlayerHP(Player) > Divide(GetPlayerMaxHP(Player), 2) Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be below 50% health to cast this spell.", White)
	Exit Function
End If

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	playermessage(player, "You need to be in a guild.", grey)
	Exit function
end if

If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, 2) = 0 Then
	playermessage(player, "You cannot use this ability without a shield!", grey)
	Exit function
end if

'If HasObj(Player, 280) >= 1 Then
'	TakeObj(Player, 280, 4) 
'Else
'	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need Ancient Relics to cast this spell!", Grey)
	'Exit function
'End If


SetPlayerFlag(Player, 109, 1)
Timer(Player, 1, "PushTimer")
Select Case GetPlayerDirection(Player)
	Case Up
		CheckX = StartX
		CheckY = StartY - 1
		DestX = CheckX
		DestY = CheckY - 1
	Case Down
		CheckX = StartX
		CheckY = StartY + 1
		DestX = CheckX
		DestY = CheckY + 1
	Case Left
		CheckX = StartX - 1
		CheckY = StartY
		DestX = CheckX - 1
		DestY = CheckY
	Case Right
		CheckX = StartX + 1
		CheckY = StartY
		DestX = CheckX + 1
		DestY = CheckY
End Select

'Check bounds, if an invalid place to check then exit the script
If CheckX < 0 | CheckY < 0 | CheckX > 11 | CheckY > 11 Then Exit Function
If DestX < 0 | DestY < 0 | DestX > 11 | DestY > 11 Then Exit Function

If RunScript3("CheckAtt", Player, CheckX, CheckY) = Stop Then Exit Function
If RunScript3("CheckAtt2", Player, CheckX, CheckY) = Stop Then Exit Function
If RunScript3("CheckAtt", Player, DestX, DestY) = Stop Then Exit Function
If RunScript3("CheckAtt2", Player, DestX, DestY) = Stop Then Exit Function
'If GetTileAtt(Map, CheckX, CheckY) > 0 Then Exit function
'If GetTileAtt(Map, DestX, DestY) > 0 Then Exit function
'If GetTileAtt2(Map, CheckX, CheckY) > 0 Then Exit function
'If GetTileAtt2(Map, DestX, DestY) > 0 Then Exit function

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
			If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
				If GetPlayerX(Loop) = CheckX Then
					If GetPlayerY(Loop) = CheckY Then 

'Target in position
						If GetPlayerHP(Loop) = GetPlayerMaxHP(Loop) Then 'Full HP
							PlayerWarp(Loop, Map, DestX, DestY)
						End If
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop



End Function

	End If
Next Loop



End Function

Sub Main(Player as Long, Target as Long)
Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, Mana as Long, XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long, MonsterLoop as Long, HP as Long



'Area of Effect - Mage Spell - Electric Pulse
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1427 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1828 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1829 Then Exit Sub

If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If

Mana = 35
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)

Effect = 5
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + 5


For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerMap(Player) Then
			XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerX(Player))
			YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerY(Player))
			If XCoord < 3 & YCoord < 3 Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
	'					HP = GetPlayerHP(Loop)
	'					If Abs(GetPlayerArmor(Loop, Damage)) >= HP Then Damage = HP - GetPlayerArmor(Loop, 1)
						MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

For XCoord = 1 to 4
	For YCoord = 1 to 4
		For MonsterLoop = 0 to 9
			If GetPlayerX(Player) - 3 + XCoord = GetMonsterX(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) & GetPlayerY(Player) - 3 + YCoord = GetMonsterY(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) Then
				MagicAttackMonster(Player, MonsterLoop, Damage)
			End If
		Next MonsterLoop
		CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Target), Target, 37, 40, 8, 0, 0)
		'CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(A), A, 9, 9, 9, 0, 0)
		'CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player) - 3 + XCoord, GetPlayerY(Player) - 3 + YCoord, Effect, 12, 0, 0, 0)
		'CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player) - 2 + XCoord, GetPlayerY(Player) - 2 + YCoord, Effect, 0, 10, 0, 0)
	Next YCoord
Next XCoord


End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Loop as Long, Mana as Long, Count as Long

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be guilded to use this.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If



if getplayerflag(player, 250) = 0 | getplayerflag(player,250) >1 then
	playermessage(player, "You must be a venerate Knight to use this spell.", white)
	exit sub
end if


Mana = (GetPlayerMaxMana(Player) - Divide(GetPlayerWisdom(Player), 2))
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate.", White)
	Exit Sub
End If
SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

PlayerMessage(Player, "=Farsight=", White)
For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If Loop <> Player Then
			If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, strcat(GetPlayerName(Loop), strcat(" - ", GetMapName(GetPlayerMap(Loop)))), Grey)
				Count = Count + 1
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

If Count = 0 Then PlayerMessage(Player, "You are alone.", Grey)

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
Dim Mana as Long, Health as Long, Energy as Long, Loop as Long
'Leech Energy

Mana = 40
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

'Stakes Arena
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1949 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You can't use this spell here!", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

'If HasObj(Player, 280) >= 1 Then
'	TakeObj(Player, 280, 1) 
'Else
'	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need Ancient Relics to cast this spell!", Grey)
'	Exit Sub
'End If

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be Guilded to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Lu Bei!", BrightGreen)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 4 & CalcY < 4 Then
					Energy = Divide(GetPlayerEnergy(Loop), 10)
					SetPlayerEnergy(Loop, GetPlayerEnergy(Loop) - Energy)
					SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerEnergy(Player) + Energy)
					If GetPlayerEnergy(Player) > GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Player) Then SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Player))
					CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 51, 40, 8, 0, 0)
					CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, str(Energy), Yellow)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Effect as Long, Damage as Long, HP as Long
Dim XCoord as Long, YCoord as Long, Loop as Long, MonsterLoop as Long

'Area of Effect - Mage Spell - Arcane Rain
'effect = 59
Effect = 3
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + 5

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 0)

For Loop = 1 to GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24) Then
			XCoord = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21))
			YCoord = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22))
			If XCoord < 2 & YCoord < 2 Then
				If Player <> Loop Then
					If GetPlayerAccess(Loop) = 0 Then
						
	'					HP = GetPlayerHP(Loop)
	'					If Abs(GetPlayerArmor(Loop, Damage)) >= HP Then Damage = HP - GetPlayerArmor(Loop, 1)
						MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

For XCoord = 1 to 3
	For YCoord = 1 to 3
		For MonsterLoop = 0 to 9
			If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) - 2 + XCoord = GetMonsterX(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) & GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) - 2 + YCoord = GetMonsterY(GetPlayerMap(Player), MonsterLoop) Then
				MagicAttackMonster(Player, MonsterLoop, Damage)
			End If
		Next MonsterLoop
		CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24), GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21) - 2 + Xcoord, GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22) - 2 + Ycoord, Effect, 33, 10, 0, 0)
	Next YCoord
Next XCoord

End Sub

FUNCTION Main(Player AS LONG, Message AS String) AS LONG
	Dim ChangeCost AS LONG
	Dim A AS LONG
	ChangeCost = 1000
	If StrCmp(Message, "knight") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 1)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 250, 1)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a venerate Knight!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough ancient relics!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "cleric") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 4)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 250, 4)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a venerate Cleric!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough ancient relics!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "mage") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 2)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 250, 2)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a venerate Mage!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough ancient relics!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If
	
	If StrCmp(Message, "rogue") Then
		For A = 1 to 5
			If GetPlayerEquipped(Player, A) > 0 Then
				PlayerMessage(Player, "You must unequip all your items first!", WHITE)
				Main = Stop
				Exit Function
			End If
		Next A
		If HasObj(Player, 6) >= ChangeCost Then
			TakeObj(Player, 6, ChangeCost)
			SetPlayerClass(Player, 3)
			SetPlayerFlag(Player, 250, 3)
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You are now a venerate Rogue!", WHITE)
		Else
			PlayerMessage(Player, "You do not have enough ancient relics!", WHITE)
		End If
		Main = Stop
		Exit Function
	End If

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
Dim CalcX as Long, CalcY as Long
Dim Mana as Long, Health as Long, Energy as Long, Loop as Long
'Leech Energy

Mana = 40
Map = GetPlayerMap(Player)
X = GetPlayerX(Player)
Y = GetPlayerY(Player)

'Stakes Arena
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1949 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You can't use this spell here!", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If



if getplayerflag(player, 250) < 3 | getplayerflag(player,250) > 3 then
	playermessage(player, "You must be a venerate Rogue to use this spell.", white)
	exit sub
end if

'If HasObj(Player, 280) >= 1 Then
'	TakeObj(Player, 280, 1) 
'Else
'	PlayerMessage(Player, "You need Ancient Relics to cast this spell!", Grey)
'	Exit Sub
'End If

If GetPlayerGuild(Player) = 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must be Guilded to cast this spell.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If
If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
	
End If
	SetPlayerFlag(Player, 23, 1)
	RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
	SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)
	'CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, "Lu Bei!", BrightGreen)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			'If GetPlayerGuild(Loop) = GetPlayerGuild(Player) Then
				CalcX = Abs(GetPlayerX(Loop) - X)
				CalcY = Abs(GetPlayerY(Loop) - Y)
				If CalcX < 2 & CalcY < 2 Then
					Energy = Divide(GetPlayerEnergy(Loop), 8)
					SetPlayerEnergy(Loop, GetPlayerEnergy(Loop) - Energy)
					'SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerEnergy(Player) + Energy)
					'If GetPlayerEnergy(Player) > GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Player) Then SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerMaxEnergy(Player))
					CreateCharacterEffect(GetPlayerMap(Loop), Loop, 3, 3, 8, 0, 0)
					'CreatePlayerFloatText(Player, str(Energy), Yellow)
				End If
			'End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

End Sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
dim Map as Long, X as Long, Y as Long
dim Damage as Long, Loop as Long, Energy as Long

Map = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 24)
X = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 21)
Y = GetPlayerFlag(Player, 22)
Damage = GetPlayerDamage(Player) + Random(6)
If Damage < 10 Then Damage = 10

RunScript1("SpellCooldown", Player)
CreateTileEffect(Map, X, Y, 1, 40, 8, 0, 0)

For Loop = 1 To GetMaxUsers()
	If IsPlaying(Loop) Then
		If GetPlayerMap(Loop) = Map Then
			If GetPlayerX(Loop) = X & GetPlayerY(Loop) = Y Then
				If Player = Loop Then
					Energy = Divide(GetPlayerEnergy(Loop), 10)
					SetPlayerEnergy(Loop, GetPlayerEnergy(Loop) - Energy)
					SetPlayerEnergy(Player, GetPlayerEnergy(Player) + Energy)
				'Else
					'MagicAttackPlayer(Player, Loop, Damage - 10)
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
Next Loop

end sub

Sub Main(Player as Long)
Dim Mana as Long
'Area of Effect - Mage Spell
If GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1427 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1828 | GetPlayerMap(Player) = 1829 | getplayermap(player) = 1949 Then Exit Sub

Mana = 40


if getplayerflag(player, 250) < 3 | getplayerflag(player,250) > 3 then
	playermessage(player, "You must be a venerate Rogue to use this spell.", white)
	exit sub
end if




If GetPlayerFlag(Player, 23) > 0 Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must wait to cast again.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

If GetPlayerMana(Player) < Mana Then
	PlayerMessage(Player, "You must regenerate before casting.", Grey)
	Exit Sub
End If

SetPlayerMana(Player, GetPlayerMana(Player) - Mana)

SetPlayerFlag(Player, 24, GetPlayerMap(Player))

CreateTileEffect(GetPlayerMap(Player), GetPlayerX(Player), GetPlayerY(Player), 50, 50, 8, 2, 0)
Timer(Player, 1, "testbomb")

End Sub
